definition_zh: 日食；月食；（天体）掩食；使黯然失色；失势、声望衰退
definition_en: the hiding of one heavenly body by another, especially the sun by the moon or the moon by the earth's shadow

scene: 操场上一群人举着带滤光片的纸板，太阳被月影咬出一个缺口，光线变得像傍晚。Through the filter, the sun shows a growing eclipse.
sceneCN: 这里 eclipse 指「一个天体遮住另一个天体的现象，此处为日食」（第 1 个义项：日食）；句意为透过滤光片看，太阳正被吞出一个逐渐扩大的缺口。图中可辨识物件：滤光纸板、太阳缺口、操场人群、偏暗天色、影子。

senses.title: A solar eclipse
senses.titleCN: 日食
senses.definition: the event in which the moon passes between the earth and the sun and hides part or all of the sun
senses.definitionCN: 月球运行到地球与太阳之间，遮住太阳一部分或全部的事件
senses.example: Through the filter, the sun shows a growing eclipse.
senses.exampleCN: 透过滤光片看，太阳正被吞出一个逐渐扩大的缺口。
senses.why: Greek ekleipsis meant 'a failing to appear', and a darkened sun is exactly a light that has failed to show.
senses.whyCN: 希腊 ekleipsis 意为「未能出现」，而变暗的太阳正是一盏未能显现的灯。

senses.title: A lunar eclipse
senses.titleCN: 月食
senses.definition: the event in which the earth's shadow falls across the moon
senses.definitionCN: 地球的影子落在月球上的事件
senses.example: The moon turned copper during the lunar eclipse.
senses.exampleCN: 月食期间月亮变成了铜红色。
senses.why: the same word covers both directions because in each case one body hides another's light.
senses.whyCN: 同一个词覆盖两个方向，因为两种情形都是一个天体挡住另一个的光。

senses.title: Any occultation
senses.titleCN: 天文学泛指掩食、掩星
senses.definition: in astronomy, any event in which one body passes in front of another and hides it
senses.definitionCN: 天文学中一个天体从另一个前面经过并遮住它的事件
senses.example: A star's eclipse by a planet revealed the planet's atmosphere.
senses.exampleCN: 行星掩住一颗恒星，从而揭示了它自己的大气。
senses.why: astronomers extended the word beyond sun and moon to any such alignment, since the geometry is identical.
senses.whyCN: 天文学家把这个词从日月扩展到任何此类连线，因为几何关系完全相同。

senses.title: To block light
senses.titleCN: 动词：遮住光
senses.definition: to cut off light from something, as one body does to another
senses.definitionCN: 挡住照向某物的光，如一个天体对另一个天体所做
senses.example: The larger moon eclipses the smaller one every few days.
senses.exampleCN: 较大的卫星每隔几天就遮住较小的那颗。
senses.why: the noun became a verb by the ordinary English route, naming the act that produces the event.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词按英语常规路径转为动词，命名产生该事件的动作。

senses.title: To surpass and overshadow
senses.titleCN: 动词：使黯然失色、盖过
senses.definition: figuratively, to be so much better or larger that another thing stops being noticed
senses.definitionCN: 比喻某事物好得多或大得多，使另一事物不再被注意
senses.example: Her second novel eclipsed everything she had written before.
senses.exampleCN: 她的第二部小说盖过了她此前写的一切。
senses.why: a total eclipse leaves no light from the hidden body, so the metaphor is about being outshone rather than defeated.
senses.whyCN: 全食时被遮住的天体不留一点光，因此这个比喻说的是被比下去，而非被打败。

senses.title: In eclipse, out of favour
senses.titleCN: 名词：失势、声望衰退
senses.definition: in the phrase in eclipse, having lost prominence or favour for a time
senses.definitionCN: 用于短语「处于失势」，指一时失去显要地位或宠爱
senses.example: The theory spent twenty years in eclipse before returning.
senses.exampleCN: 这个理论失势二十年之后又回来了。
senses.why: when a body is eclipsed it is temporarily invisible, so the phrase describes fame that has gone dark for a while.
senses.whyCN: 天体被食时暂时不可见，因此这个短语形容名声暂时暗了下去。

senses.title: Total, partial and annular
senses.titleCN: 全食、偏食与环食
senses.definition: used in fixed labels for how much of the sun or moon is covered and in what geometry
senses.definitionCN: 用于固定标签，说明日月被遮住多少以及何种几何关系
senses.example: An annular eclipse leaves a ring of sunlight visible.
senses.exampleCN: 环食会留下一圈可见的阳光。
senses.why: the labels exist because distance and alignment decide whether the covering is complete or leaves a ring.
senses.whyCN: 这些标签存在，是因为距离与连线决定遮盖是完整的还是留下一圈。

senses.title: The eclipse cycle
senses.titleCN: 食的周期与预报
senses.definition: the repeating rhythm, roughly eighteen years, on which similar eclipses recur and can be predicted
senses.definitionCN: 相似食象重复出现并可被预报的节律，约十八年
senses.example: Ancient astronomers used the cycle to predict the next eclipse.
senses.exampleCN: 古代天文学家利用这个周期预报下一次食。
senses.why: because the rhythm is regular, the word also names the timetable, not only the event.
senses.whyCN: 由于节律规律，这个词也命名时刻表，而不只是事件本身。

senses.title: The eclipse phase in virology
senses.titleCN: 病毒学中的隐蔽期
senses.definition: in virology, the period after a virus enters a cell when no complete virus can be detected
senses.definitionCN: 病毒进入细胞后、检测不到完整病毒的那段时间
senses.example: During the eclipse phase the virus seems to vanish.
senses.exampleCN: 在隐蔽期，病毒似乎消失了。
senses.why: the virus is present but invisible to assay, exactly the state the astronomical word describes.
senses.whyCN: 病毒仍在，却检测不到，正是这个天文学词所描述的状态。

intro.en: Eclipse comes from Greek ekleipsis 'abandonment, failure to appear', from ekleipein 'to leave out, fail'. It reached English through Latin and French. The figurative sense is early modern. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: eclipse 来自希腊 ekleipsis「抛弃、未能出现」，源自动词 ekleipein「遗漏、失败」。它经拉丁语与法语进入英语。比喻义出现于近代早期。年代均为约数。

items.en: Ekleipsis meant a leaving out or a failure, especially of a heavenly body to appear as expected.
items.cn: ekleipsis 意为遗漏或失败，尤指天体未如预期出现。

items.en: The verb combined ek- 'out' with leipein 'to leave', giving 'to leave out, forsake, fail'.
items.cn: 这个动词由 ek-「出」与 leipein「离开」组合，意为「遗漏、抛弃、失败」。

items.en: Greek leipein and Latin linquere 'to leave' descend from the same Indo-European root, so relic and eclipse are distant cousins.
items.cn: 希腊 leipein 与拉丁 linquere「离开」同出印欧词根，因此 relic 与 eclipse 是远亲。

items.en: Latin borrowed the Greek noun as eclipsis, and medieval writers used it for both sun and moon.
items.cn: 拉丁语借作 eclipsis，中世纪作者用它指日食与月食。

items.en: English eclipse appears in the Middle Ages; the sense 'to outshine' develops later and is common by the seventeenth century.
items.cn: 英语 eclipse 见于中世纪；「使黯然失色」义后来发展，到 17 世纪已常见。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date): the earliest English use is not firmly dated, and the precise Indo-European shape behind leipein is a reconstruction.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代）：最早的英语用例没有可靠年代；leipein 背后确切的印欧形态属重构。

note.en: Group one holds words from the same Greek root with different meanings; group two holds terms for one body hiding another.
note.cn: 第一组是同出希腊词根但意义不同的词；第二组是一个天体遮住另一个的术语。

entries.definition: The plane of the sun's apparent yearly path, named from the same root because eclipses occur on it; it is a path, not an event.
entries.definitionCN: 太阳视运动年路径所在的平面，因食发生于此而得名；它是路径，而非事件。

entries.definition: From Greek elleipsis 'a falling short', with en- 'in' rather than ek- 'out'; it means words left out, not light hidden.
entries.definitionCN: 来自希腊 elleipsis「欠缺」，用 en-「在内」而非 ek-「在外」；指省略的词，而非被遮的光。

entries.definition: The closed oval from the same 'falling short' root; orbits are ellipses, but an ellipse is not an eclipse.
entries.definitionCN: 同出「欠缺」词根的闭合椭圆；轨道是椭圆，但椭圆不是食。

entries.definition: The roughly eighteen-year cycle after which similar eclipses recur; it names the rhythm rather than the darkening.
entries.definitionCN: 约十八年的周期，相似食象此后重现；命名节律，而非变暗本身。

entries.definition: The passing of one body in front of another, from Latin 'hiding'; it is the technical term where eclipse is the familiar one.
entries.definitionCN: 一个天体从另一个前面经过，来自拉丁「隐藏」；是 eclipse 的技术对应词。

entries.definition: The passage of a small body across the face of a larger one; the small body is seen, so it is not always an eclipse.
entries.definitionCN: 小天体横过大天体表面；小天体可见，因此不总是食。

entries.definition: To cast a shadow over or surpass; it matches the 'outshine' sense without astronomy.
entries.definitionCN: 投下阴影或超过；对应「使黯然失色」义，但不涉天文学。

entries.definition: To keep something from being seen, usually on purpose; an eclipse hides light by geometry, not intention.
entries.definitionCN: 有意不让人看见；食是按几何关系遮光，而非有意。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real roots, real terms and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实词根、真实术语与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Greek ek- 'out' + leipein 'leave': the light leaves, so the body fails to appear.
normal.cn: 希腊 ek-「出」+ leipein「离开」：光离开了，于是天体未能出现。

normal.en: Latin linquere 'to leave' shares the root, which links eclipse to relic.
normal.cn: 拉丁 linquere「离开」共享词根，把 eclipse 与 relic 联系起来。

normal.en: Fixed terms: solar eclipse, lunar eclipse, total, partial, annular.
normal.cn: 固定术语：日食、月食、全食、偏食、环食。

normal.en: The family runs eclipses, eclipsed, eclipsing, eclipse phase, ecliptic.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 eclipses、eclipsed、eclipsing、eclipse phase、ecliptic。

normal.en: The saros cycle of about eighteen years lets astronomers predict eclipses.
normal.cn: 约十八年的沙罗周期让天文学家能预报食。

abstract.en: Picture a hand passing in front of a lamp and taking the room's light with it.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手从灯前经过，把屋里的光也带走。

abstract.en: Picture a famous singer walking on stage and making the opening act invisible.
abstract.cn: 想象一位名歌手登台，让暖场者变得无人看见。

abstract.en: Picture a virus that is there but cannot be found for a while.
abstract.cn: 想象一种病毒明明在场，却有一阵子找不到。

examples.en: Never look at a solar eclipse without a proper filter.
examples.cn: 绝不要在没有合适滤光片的情况下直视日食。

examples.en: The new bridge eclipsed every earlier attempt to cross the river.
examples.cn: 这座新桥盖过了此前所有跨河尝试。

examples.en: The comet spent a decade in eclipse before observers returned to it.
examples.cn: 这颗彗星失势十年后，观测者才重新关注它。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses begin with the darkened sun, move to the darkened moon, to any occultation, to the verb of blocking, to outshining, to lost favour, to the labels of totality, to the cycle and finally to a virus that cannot be found.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项从变暗的太阳开始，走到变暗的月亮、任何掩食、遮光的动词、盖过他人、失势、全食偏食等标签、周期，最后落到一种找不到的病毒。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a dark bite taken out of a bright disk, with the sky turning dusk.
core.cn: 核心意象：明亮圆盘被咬出一个黑色缺口，天色转暗。

branches.en: TWO DIRECTIONS: the moon hides the sun, then the earth's shadow hides the moon.
branches.cn: 两个方向：月球遮太阳，地球影子遮月球。

branches.en: GEOMETRY AND LABELS: any alignment counts, and distance decides total, partial or annular.
branches.cn: 几何与标签：任何连线都算，距离决定全食、偏食或环食。

branches.en: BLOCKING AND BEATING: the physical act becomes a figure for being outshone.
branches.cn: 遮挡与胜过：物理动作变成被比下去的修辞。

branches.en: TIME DARK AND TIME CYCLIC: favour goes dark, while eclipses return on schedule.
branches.cn: 变暗的时间与循环的时间：声望暗下去，而食按期回来。

branches.en: INVISIBLE BUT PRESENT: virology borrows the same dark interval.
branches.cn: 不可见却在场：病毒学借用了同一段黑暗间隔。

intro.en: Eclipse is a Greek compound with a prefix, a verb root and a noun ending; Latin and French carried it to English.
intro.cn: eclipse 是希腊复合词，含一个前缀、一个动词词根与一个名词词尾；经拉丁语与法语传入英语。

latinIntro.en: Latin eclipsis is a straight borrowing of the Greek noun; Latin also said defectus solis, 'failure of the sun', for the same event.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 eclipsis 是对希腊名词的直接借入；拉丁也用 defectus solis「太阳的缺失」指同一事件。

senses.title: The yearly road of the sun
senses.titleCN: 黄道
senses.definition: the great circle on the celestial sphere along which the sun appears to move during the year
senses.definitionCN: （名词）太阳一年中在天球上看起来走过的那个大圆，即黄道
senses.example: The planets all stay close to the ecliptic as they wander.
senses.exampleCN: 行星在天上漫游时，都离黄道很近。
senses.why: A year of noon marks drawn on a star chart joins into one tilted circle across the constellations.
senses.whyCN: 把一年里每天正午太阳的位置标在星图上，连起来就是一条横穿星座的倾斜圆线。

senses.title: Belonging to that road
senses.titleCN: 黄道的
senses.definition: relating to that circle or to eclipses
senses.definitionCN: （形容词）黄道的；与食有关的
senses.example: Ecliptic latitude is measured north or south of that circle.
senses.exampleCN: 黄纬是从那条圆线向南或向北量出的。
senses.why: A shadow only falls on the Earth when the moon stands on that same tilted line.
senses.whyCN: 只有当月亮正好站在那条倾斜的线上，影子才会落到地球上。

senses.title: The baseline for tilts
senses.titleCN: 倾角的基准
senses.definition: the reference plane from which the tilt of an orbit is measured
senses.definitionCN: （名词）测量轨道倾角所用的基准面，即黄道面
senses.example: The probe orbit has an inclination of six degrees to the ecliptic.
senses.exampleCN: 这条探测器轨道相对黄道有六度的倾角。
senses.why: A probe trajectory is labelled with its tilt measured from that one reference circle.
senses.whyCN: 探测器轨道旁标着一个倾角，那是从这条唯一的基准圆量出来的。

intro.en: Ecliptic comes from Greek ekleiptikos, meaning of an eclipse, built on ekleipsis from ek- meaning out and leipein meaning to leave; the circle took that name because an eclipse can only happen when the moon stands on it.
intro.cn: ecliptic 来自希腊语 ekleiptikos，意为「食的」，建立在 ekleipsis 之上，而后者由 ek-（出）与 leipein（留下）组成；这条圆线之所以叫这个名字，是因为只有月亮站到它上面时才可能发生食。

items.en: Greek leipein means to leave or to leave behind.
items.cn: 希腊语 leipein 意为离开、留下。

items.en: Greek ekleipsis joins ek- meaning out to leipein, a leaving out, and gives eclipse.
items.cn: 希腊语 ekleipsis 把 ek-（出）与 leipein 结合，意为「缺掉」，给出 eclipse。

items.en: Greek ekleiptikos means of an eclipse, because eclipses happen only on this line.
items.cn: 希腊语 ekleiptikos 意为「食的」，因为食只发生在这条线上。

items.en: Latin eclipticus carried the term into medieval astronomy.
items.cn: 拉丁语 eclipticus 把这个词带进中世纪天文学。

items.en: The circle took the name ecliptic in English star charts.
items.cn: 这条圆线在英文星图上得名 ecliptic。

items.en: Spacecraft navigation still measures inclination against the ecliptic.
items.cn: 航天器导航仍以黄道为基准测量倾角。

note.en: Ecliptic and eclipse share the Greek leipein, to leave; the ecliptic is the line where a leaving out can happen, while ellipse and ellipsis keep the same root in geometry and grammar.
note.cn: ecliptic 与 eclipse 共用希腊语 leipein（留下）；黄道是可能发生「缺掉」的那条线，而 ellipse 与 ellipsis 把同一词根保留在几何与语法里。

examples.en: The probe orbit has an inclination of six degrees to the ecliptic.
examples.cn: 这条探测器轨道相对黄道有六度的倾角。

dict_mnemonic.text: ecliptic 与 eclipse 同根：希腊语 ek-（出）＋ leipein（留下）＝ ekleipsis「缺掉、离开」→ eclipse「食」。形容词 ekleiptikos 意为「食的」，为什么变成「黄道」？因为日食月食只发生在太阳走的那条线附近——月亮必须正好站到这条线上，影子才落得到地球。于是「食的那条线」就成了「黄道」。记忆钩子：ecliptic ＝ eclipse 的线。派生 ecliptical 同义；同根还有 ellipse（椭圆）、ellipsis（省略），都带着 leipein「留下、缺掉」的影子。搭配 the ecliptic plane 黄道面、ecliptic longitude 黄经、ecliptic latitude 黄纬、obliquity of the ecliptic 黄赤交角；近义 orbit 指任一轨道，equator 是另一个大圆（赤道），zodiac 是沿黄道的那一圈星座带。

root: 希腊语 ek-（出）＋ leipein（留下）→ ekleipsis（缺掉）→ ekleiptikos（食的）→ 拉丁语 eclipticus → ecliptic（黄道；黄道的）

sensesIntro.en: One tilted circle: the road the sun appears to follow, the line where a shadow can reach the Earth, and the ruler against which every orbit is tilted.
sensesIntro.cn: 一条倾斜的圆：太阳看起来走过的路、影子能够到地球的那条线，以及量出每条轨道倾角的那把尺。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a year of noon marks on a star chart joins into one tilted circle across the constellations
core.cn: 核心意象：星图上一年里每天正午的太阳位置，连成一条横穿星座的倾斜圆线

branches.en: The great circle the sun appears to follow.
branches.cn: 太阳看起来走过的那个大圆。

branches.en: Belonging to that circle or to eclipses.
branches.cn: 属于那条圆线或属于食的。

branches.en: The baseline against which orbits are tilted.
branches.cn: 测量轨道倾角所用的基准线。

branches.en: The road itself and the word describing it.
branches.cn: 那条路线本身与描述它的词。

branches.en: One circle serves as both path and ruler.
branches.cn: 同一个圆既是路径也是尺子。

intro.en: Ecliptic is ec- plus leip- plus -tic; the same leipein gives ellipse and ellipsis, while orbit and equator come from Latin.
intro.cn: ecliptic 由 ec- 加 leip- 加 -tic 组成；同一个 leipein 给出 ellipse 与 ellipsis，而 orbit 与 equator 来自拉丁语。

latinIntro.en: Greek leipein means to leave and ek out of; Latin orbis means a wheel rim and aequus means equal, the roots of orbit and equator.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语 leipein 意为留下，ek 意为出；拉丁语 orbis 意为轮辋，aequus 意为相等，分别是 orbit 与 equator 的词根。

definition_zh: 生态的；生态学的；与环境相关的；生态平衡的；生态影响／足迹的；生态农业的；生态效度的；生态谬误的
definition_en: relating to ecology as a science, to the relations between organisms and their environments, or to environmental protection and impact
core_image: 一张看不见的网把溪水、鱼、岸边树木和坡上的农田都连在同一根线上
scene: 一条溪、溪里的鱼、岸边的树与坡上的农田，被一张看不见的网连成一体。The stream, its fish, the trees and the farm form one ecological system.
sceneCN: 这里 ecological 是「生态的、生物与环境相互关联的」（第 1 个义项：生态学的）；句意：溪水、溪鱼、岸边树木与坡上农田构成一个生态整体，被一张看不见的网连在一起。图中可辨识物件：溪流、游鱼、岸边树根、坡地农田、代表联系的无形线条。

pos.zh: 生态的；生态学的；与环境相关的

collocations.zh: 生态效度（研究结论在真实情境中的适用性）

senses.title: Of ecology as a science: what ecologists study
senses.titleCN: 生态学的：生态学家所研究的那一类
senses.definition: relating to ecology, the scientific study of organisms and their environments
senses.definitionCN: 与生态学——研究生物与其环境关系的科学——相关的
senses.example: The paper reports ecological data from twenty lakes.
senses.exampleCN: 这篇论文报告了来自二十个湖泊的生态学数据。
senses.why: Ecological is ecology plus -ical. Ecology was coined by Haeckel from Greek oikos 'house' plus -logia 'study of', so ecological literally means 'of the study of the household of life'.
senses.whyCN: ecological 是 ecology 加 -ical。ecology 由海克尔用希腊语 oikos“房屋”加 -logia“研究”造出，所以 ecological 字面就是“关于生命之家户之研究的”。

senses.title: Of the environment: nature and its condition
senses.titleCN: 环境的：自然及其状况
senses.definition: relating to the natural environment and the state of its systems
senses.definitionCN: 与自然环境及其系统状态相关的
senses.example: The dam caused ecological damage far downstream.
senses.exampleCN: 这座大坝在远下游造成了生态破坏。
senses.why: In public usage the adjective often drops the science and keeps the object: ecological means 'of the environment'. The focus shifts from researchers to rivers.
senses.whyCN: 在大众用法中，这个形容词常丢掉“学科”而保留“对象”：ecological 就是“环境的”。焦点从研究者转到河流。

senses.title: Of interactions: relations among organisms
senses.titleCN: 相互作用的：生物之间的关系
senses.definition: concerning the relationships between organisms or between organisms and their surroundings
senses.definitionCN: 关于生物之间、或生物与其周围环境之间关系的
senses.example: The beetle plays an ecological role far beyond its size.
senses.exampleCN: 这种甲虫的生态作用远超它的体型。
senses.why: The core of ecology is relation, not scenery. Ecological therefore often describes a role or link — pollinator, predator, decomposer — rather than a place.
senses.whyCN: 生态学的核心是关系，而不是风景。因此 ecological 常修饰角色或联系——传粉者、捕食者、分解者——而不是地点。

senses.title: Of impact: the footprint left on a system
senses.titleCN: 影响面的：留在系统上的足迹
senses.definition: concerning the measurable effect of human activity on ecosystems
senses.definitionCN: 关于人类活动对生态系统可测量的影响
senses.example: The city's ecological footprint is larger than its area suggests.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城市的生态足迹比它的面积所显示的要大。
senses.why: This sense converts the relation into a debt: resources taken and waste returned are added up as area. The adjective becomes quantitative without losing its 'web' image.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项把关系换算成欠账：取走的资源与归还的废物被折算成面积。形容词变得可量化，却没有丢掉“网”的意象。

senses.title: Of balance: a system staying healthy
senses.titleCN: 平衡的：系统保持健康
senses.definition: concerning the stability and health of an ecosystem's internal relations
senses.definitionCN: 关于生态系统内部关系的稳定与健康
senses.example: Wetlands maintain the ecological balance of the floodplain.
senses.exampleCN: 湿地维持着洪泛平原的生态平衡。
senses.why: Balance is a metaphor inside the metaphor: the web is imagined as a scale that can tip. Ecological here means 'capable of keeping the web from tipping'.
senses.whyCN: 平衡是隐喻中的隐喻：那张网被想象成一架会倾斜的天平。这里的 ecological 意为“能让网不倾覆的”。

senses.title: Of practice: farming and industry shaped by ecology
senses.titleCN: 实践上的：按生态学塑形的农业与产业
senses.definition: describing methods designed to work with ecosystems rather than against them
senses.definitionCN: 描述顺应而非对抗生态系统的做法
senses.example: Ecological farming replaced chemical spraying with predators.
senses.exampleCN: 生态农业用天敌取代了化学喷药。
senses.why: Here the adjective moves from describing nature to prescribing conduct. An ecological method is one whose design copies the relations the science discovered.
senses.whyCN: 这里形容词从“描述自然”转为“规定行为”。所谓生态的方法，就是其设计模仿了科学所发现的关系。

senses.title: Of validity: findings that hold outside the lab
senses.titleCN: 效度的：结论在实验室外也成立
senses.definition: describing research whose conditions resemble real-world settings closely enough to generalise
senses.definitionCN: 描述研究条件足够接近真实世界、因而可推广
senses.example: The memory study was criticised for low ecological validity.
senses.exampleCN: 这项记忆研究因生态效度低而受到批评。
senses.why: Psychology borrowed the word for a different kind of relation: not organism to habitat, but task to real life. Ecological validity asks whether the lab's little web resembles the world's big one.
senses.whyCN: 心理学借这个词表达另一种关系：不是生物与生境，而是任务与真实生活。生态效度问的是：实验室的小网是否像世界的大网。

senses.title: Of fallacy: a group pattern wrongly applied to individuals
senses.titleCN: 谬误的：把群体模式错加给个人
senses.definition: describing the error of inferring individual traits from aggregate group statistics
senses.definitionCN: 描述由群体汇总统计推断个体特征的错误
senses.example: Assuming every resident is wealthy is an ecological fallacy.
senses.exampleCN: 假定每位居民都富有，是一种生态谬误。
senses.why: The name comes from early studies of areal groups, where 'ecological' meant grouped by region. The fallacy is to read a map of averages as a description of persons.
senses.whyCN: 这个名称来自早期对地域群体的研究，那里的 ecological 指“按地区分组的”。该谬误就是把平均值地图当成对个人的描述。

intro.en: Ecological is ecology plus -ical. Ecology was coined by the German zoologist Ernst Haeckel, first as Oecologie in 1866 and recorded in English in the 1870s, from Greek oikos 'house, dwelling' plus -logia 'study of'. The adjective follows the noun and is not an inherited Latin word.
intro.cn: 一般认为，ecological 是 ecology 加 -ical。ecology 由德国动物学家恩斯特·海克尔所造，1866 年作 Oecologie，英语在 1870 年代见诸记载，由希腊语 oikos“房屋、居所”加 -logia“研究”构成。这个形容词随名词而造，并非继承的拉丁词。

items.en: The adjective extends into policy, agriculture, psychology and statistics, each adding a different noun after it: footprint, farming, validity, fallacy.
items.cn: 这个形容词扩展到政策、农业、心理学和统计学，各自接上不同的名词：footprint、farming、validity、fallacy。

items.en: English ecology and ecological are recorded, spreading Haeckel's German coinage through British and American science.
items.cn: 英语 ecology 与 ecological 一般认为在 1870 年代见于记载（确切年份来源不确定），把海克尔的德语新造词传播到英美科学界。

items.en: Haeckel proposes Oecologie for the relation of organisms to their environment, using Greek oikos 'house' as the image of a shared dwelling.
items.cn: 海克尔提出 Oecologie，指生物与其环境的关系，用希腊语 oikos“房屋”作为共同居所的意象。

items.en: oikos 'house, household' is the base of oikonomia 'household management' and oikoumene 'the inhabited world', so ecology, economy and ecumenical all begin from one house.
items.cn: oikos“房屋、家户”是 oikonomia“家务管理”与 oikoumene“有人居住的世界”的词基，因此 ecology、economy、ecumenical 都从同一座房子出发。

items.en: -logia comes from logos 'word, account, reasoning', from legein 'to gather, say'. Ecology is thus a 'account of the house' rather than a 'law of the house'; the law sense belongs to -nomia.
items.cn: -logia 出自 logos“言说、论述、推理”，再上为 legein“聚集、说”。所以 ecology 是“关于家户的论述”，而不是“家户的法则”；“法则”义属于 -nomia。

note.en: The first group separates a shared-house relative and two accidental neighbours; the second compares words that share only part of the meaning.
note.cn: 第一组区分一个同屋同源的词和两个偶然撞形的词；第二组比较只共享部分含义的词。

entries.definition: thrifty, or relating to saving money. It shares oikos 'house' but adds nomos 'managing, law', so it concerns household management, not the study of life.
entries.definitionCN: 节约的；与省钱相关的。它与 ecological 共享 oikos“房屋”，但接的是 nomos“管理、法则”，因此讲的是家务管理，不是生命研究。

entries.definition: selecting from many sources. It comes from Greek eklektikos 'selective', from eklegein 'to pick out', and only looks like eco-.
entries.definitionCN: 从多种来源中选取的。它出自希腊语 eklektikos“挑选的”，源于 eklegein“挑出”，只是看起来像 eco-。

entries.definition: a reflected sound. It comes from Greek ēkhē 'sound', with no relation to oikos 'house'.
entries.definitionCN: 回声。它出自希腊语 ēkhē“声音”，与 oikos“房屋”无关。

entries.definition: relating to the surroundings of living things. It is broader and less relational than ecological, which stresses interactions.
entries.definitionCN: 与生物周围环境相关的。它比 ecological 更宽、更少讲关系，而 ecological 强调相互作用。

entries.definition: environmentally friendly, in everyday speech. It is a stance or label, where ecological is a descriptive relation.
entries.definitionCN: 日常口语中“环保的”。它是一种立场或标签，而 ecological 是描述性关系。

entries.definition: relating to a whole ecosystem as a system. It is more technical and more whole-oriented than ecological.
entries.definitionCN: 把整个生态系统当作系统来看的。它比 ecological 更技术化、更强调整体。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real parts of the word and its real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想只使用这个词真实的构成成分和真实同族词，不用编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: ecological is ecology plus -ical; -ical is the adjective suffix seen in biological and geological.
normal.cn: ecological 是 ecology 加 -ical；-ical 是 biological、geological 里那个形容词后缀。

normal.en: eco- comes from Greek oikos 'house', not from 'eco' as a brand of anything.
normal.cn: eco- 出自希腊语 oikos“房屋”，不是任何品牌的“eco”。

normal.en: -logy is 'study of', so ecology is the study of the household of life; -nomy in economy is 'managing', a different second half.
normal.cn: -logy 是“研究”，所以 ecology 是研究生命之家户；economy 里的 -nomy 是“管理”，后半截不同。

normal.en: ecological validity and ecological fallacy are both statistical uses, not nature uses.
normal.cn: ecological validity 与 ecological fallacy 都是统计学用法，不是自然用法。

normal.en: The adjective keeps the noun's web image: a stream, its fish, the trees and the farm are one linked system.
normal.cn: 这个形容词保留名词的“网”意象：溪水、鱼、树、农田是一个相连的系统。

abstract.en: Picture an invisible net laid over a valley: every knot is an organism, every line a relation.
abstract.cn: 想象一张看不见的网铺在山谷上：每个结是一个生物，每条线是一种关系。

abstract.en: The same net explains a role, an impact, a balance, a farming method, a lab's realism and a statistical error.
abstract.cn: 同一张网可以解释一个角色、一种影响、一种平衡、一种耕作法、一间实验室的真实度，以及一个统计错误。

abstract.en: Every sense asks one question: what is tied to what, and what happens when one knot moves?
abstract.cn: 每个义项都在问一个问题：什么与什么相连，当一个结移动时会发生什么？

examples.en: The report assessed the ecological impact of the new port.
examples.cn: 这份报告评估了新港口的生态影响。

examples.en: Beavers play an ecological role by building wetlands.
examples.cn: 河狸通过筑造湿地发挥生态作用。

examples.en: Ecological farming uses predators instead of pesticides.
examples.cn: 生态农业用天敌代替杀虫剂。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「一口逻辑」——一口水、一口土都讲逻辑，万物相互牵连 → ecological 生态的

root: 希腊语 oikos“房屋、家户”＋-logia“研究、论述”（logos“言说、推理”）→ ecology“生态学”；再加 -ical（形容词后缀）→ ecological。核心是“把自然看成一户人家，成员彼此相连”。

sensesIntro.en: All eight senses keep the image of a net of relations. What changes is the question asked of the net: what is it, how is it damaged, who fills which role, how much is taken, how it stays balanced, how we imitate it, whether a study resembles it, or how it is misread.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都保留“关系之网”的意象。变化的只是对这张网提出的问题：它是什么、如何受损、谁担任什么角色、取走多少、如何保持平衡、我们如何模仿它、研究是否像它、以及它如何被误读。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an invisible net ties stream, fish, trees and farmland into one system.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张看不见的网把溪水、鱼、树、农田连成一个系统。

branches.en: THE SCIENCE AND ITS RELATIONS: ecology studies the household, and ecological marks what belongs to that study or to its web of roles.
branches.cn: 学科及其关系：生态学研究这个“家户”，ecological 标记属于该研究或其角色之网的东西。

branches.en: CONDITION AND BALANCE: the net can be described as healthy or as tipping, which yields environmental damage and ecological balance.
branches.cn: 状况与平衡：这张网可以被描述为健康或正在倾覆，于是有生态破坏与生态平衡。

branches.en: ACCOUNTING: impact converts relations into a measurable footprint of land and resources.
branches.cn: 记账：影响把关系换算成可测量的土地与资源足迹。

branches.en: IMITATION: ecological farming copies the relations the science describes instead of overriding them.
branches.cn: 模仿：生态农业复制科学所描述的关系，而不是压过它们。

branches.en: TWO STATISTICAL EXTENSIONS: one asks whether a study resembles the real net; the other warns against reading group averages as persons.
branches.cn: 两个统计学延伸：一个问研究是否像真实的网；另一个警告不要把群体平均值读成个人。

intro.en: Ecological is ecology plus -ical. The suffix -ical, from Latin -icalis and Greek -ikos, turns a noun into an adjective of relation; the base ecology is a 19th-century scientific coinage from Greek elements.
intro.cn: ecological 是 ecology 加 -ical。后缀 -ical 出自拉丁语 -icalis 与希腊语 -ikos，把名词变成关系形容词；词基 ecology 则是 19 世纪用希腊语成分造出的科学新词。

latinIntro.en: The Greek pieces are oikos 'house, household' and -logia 'study, discourse'. oikos also gives economy and ecumenical; -logia gives biology, geology and psychology.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊成分是 oikos“房屋、家户”和 -logia“研究、论述”。oikos 还给出 economy、ecumenical；-logia 给出 biology、geology、psychology。

items.meaning: relating to ecology or to organism-environment relations
items.meaningCN: 与生态学或生物—环境关系相关的（-ical 构成关系形容词）
items.example: The reserve was chosen for its ecological value.
items.exampleCN: 这片保护区因生态价值而被选定。

items.meaning: the science of organisms and their environments
items.meaningCN: 研究生物与其环境的科学（eco- 表“家户”，-logy 表“研究”）
items.example: Ecology treats a forest as a system, not a list of trees.
items.exampleCN: 生态学把森林看作一个系统，而不是一份树木清单。

items.meaning: from an ecological point of view
items.exampleCN: 这条山谷在生态上很脆弱。

items.meaningCN: 生态学家（-ist 表示从事某学科的人）
items.example: An ecologist surveyed the marsh for three seasons.
items.exampleCN: 一位生态学家对这片沼泽做了三季调查。

items.meaning: a community and its environment treated as one unit
items.meaningCN: 生物群落与其环境构成的统一整体
items.example: The reef is a fragile ecosystem.
items.exampleCN: 珊瑚礁是一个脆弱的生态系统。

items.meaningCN: 对生态系统的大规模破坏（-cide 表示“杀”）
items.example: The spill was called ecocide by local groups.
items.exampleCN: 当地团体把这次泄漏称为生态灭绝。

items.meaning: a transition zone between two ecosystems
items.meaningCN: 两个生态系统之间的过渡带
items.exampleCN: 物种在生态过渡带上混合分布。

items.meaning: a large regional community of life
items.meaningCN: 大尺度生物群落区（生物群系）
items.example: The taiga is the largest forest biome.
items.exampleCN: 泰加林是最大的森林生物群系。

items.meaning: the place where an organism lives
items.exampleCN: 排水毁掉了这种蛙的栖息地。

items.meaning: the capacity to keep a system going without depletion
items.meaningCN: 可持续性；维持系统不耗竭的能力
items.example: The plan's sustainability depends on the water table.
items.exampleCN: 该方案的可持续性取决于地下水位。

latinEntries.meaning: the study of the household of nature; the form behind ecology
latinEntries.meaningCN: 关于自然家户的研究；ecology 所本的构词形式

definition_zh: 生态学家；研究生物与环境关系的科学家；野外生态调查者；生态保护倡导者；生态模型与数据分析者；修复生态学家；按类群分工的生态学家；生态咨询顾问
definition_en: a person who studies ecology: the relations between organisms and their environments, whether in the field, in models, or in conservation practice
core_image: 一个人跪在浅水里数着卵石下的幼虫，笔记本被溅湿了一半
scene: 浅水里跪着一位研究者，正数着卵石下的幼虫，她就是一位野外生态学家。The researcher kneeling in the shallows is a field ecologist counting larvae.
sceneCN: 这里 ecologist 是「做野外生态调查的人」（第 2 个义项：野外生态调查者）；句意：跪在浅水里的研究者是一位野外生态学家，正在数石头下的幼虫。图中可辨识物件：浅水、翻起的卵石、幼虫、湿透的笔记本、装样品的塑料瓶。

pos.zh: 生态学家；生态研究工作者；生态保护者

senses.title: The scientist: one who studies ecology
senses.titleCN: 科学家：以生态学为专业的人
senses.definition: a scientist whose discipline is the study of organisms and their environments
senses.definitionCN: 以研究生物与其环境关系为学科专业的科学家
senses.example: The ecologist argued that the two lakes differ in nutrient flow, not in size.
senses.exampleCN: 这位生态学家认为，两个湖的差别在养分流动，而不在面积。
senses.why: Ecologist is ecology plus -ist, the person suffix from Greek -istēs. Ecology itself was coined from oikos 'house' and -logia 'study', so the person is literally 'one who studies the household of life'.
senses.whyCN: ecologist 是 ecology 加 -ist，后者出自希腊语 -istēs，表示从事某学科的人。ecology 本身由 oikos“房屋”与 -logia“研究”构成，所以这个人字面上就是“研究生命之家户的人”。

senses.title: The field worker: counting in the mud
senses.titleCN: 野外工作者：在泥里做计数
senses.definition: a researcher who gathers ecological data outdoors rather than only from models or archives
senses.definitionCN: 在户外而非仅从模型或档案中获取生态数据的研究者
senses.example: A field ecologist spent the summer tagging young bats.
senses.exampleCN: 一位野外生态学家整个夏天都在给幼蝠上标记。
senses.why: Because ecology's object is a relation in a real place, its practitioners must go there. The word in this sense names a method as much as a degree: boots, nets, quadrats.
senses.whyCN: 因为生态学的对象是真实地点中的关系，从业者必须到现场。这个义项里的词，既指一种学位，也指一种方法：靴子、网、样方。

senses.title: The advocate: using ecology for protection
senses.titleCN: 倡导者：用生态学推动保护
senses.definition: a person who applies ecological knowledge to defend species, habitats, or ecosystems
senses.definitionCN: 运用生态学知识来保护物种、生境或生态系统的人
senses.example: The ecologist testified against draining the marsh.
senses.exampleCN: 这位生态学家出庭作证，反对排干这片沼泽。
senses.why: The suffix -ist also marks a role in public life. When the study's findings are used in argument, 'ecologist' shifts from researcher to witness for a place that cannot speak.
senses.whyCN: -ist 也标记公共生活中的角色。当研究结论被用于论辩时，ecologist 就从研究者转为替一个无法开口的地方作证的人。

senses.title: The modeller: turning relations into equations
senses.titleCN: 建模者：把关系写成方程
senses.definition: a researcher who represents ecological processes in mathematical or computational models
senses.definitionCN: 用数学或计算模型表示生态过程的研究者
senses.example: A theoretical ecologist predicted the collapse before it was visible.
senses.exampleCN: 一位理论生态学家在崩溃可见之前就预测到了它。
senses.why: Ecology's relations can be counted, so a branch of the field works indoors with parameters instead of quadrats. The person noun stays the same, but the tools change.
senses.whyCN: 生态学的关系可以计数，于是有分支在室内用参数而非样方工作。人这个名词不变，工具却换了。

senses.title: The restorer: rebuilding a broken system
senses.titleCN: 修复者：重建受损的系统
senses.definition: a specialist who plans and monitors the recovery of a degraded ecosystem
senses.definitionCN: 规划并监测退化生态系统恢复的专门人员
senses.example: A restoration ecologist chose native grasses for the old quarry.
senses.exampleCN: 一位修复生态学家为这座旧采石场选用了本地草种。
senses.why: Restoration adds a purpose to the study: the ecologist does not only describe the web but tries to re-weave it. The compound names a practical branch of the discipline.
senses.whyCN: 修复给研究加上了目的：生态学家不只描述这张网，还试着把它重新织起来。这个复合词命名了该学科的一个实践分支。

senses.title: The specialist: named by the group studied
senses.titleCN: 专门家：按研究类群命名
senses.definition: a researcher identified by the kind of organism or habitat they study, as in plant ecologist or microbial ecologist
senses.definitionCN: 按所研究的生物类群或生境来称呼的研究者，如植物生态学家、微生物生态学家
senses.example: A microbial ecologist found the bacteria living two kilometres underground.
senses.exampleCN: 一位微生物生态学家发现了生活在两公里地下的细菌。
senses.why: When ecology became a profession, its division of labour followed taxa. The modifier before 'ecologist' is not decoration; it states which part of the web the person follows.
senses.whyCN: 生态学成为专业后，分工按类群展开。ecologist 前的修饰语并非装饰，它说明这个人追踪的是网上的哪一部分。

senses.title: The historian of nature: reading old systems
senses.titleCN: 自然史研究者：读取旧系统
senses.definition: a researcher who reconstructs past ecological conditions from sediments, pollen, or old records
senses.definitionCN: 从沉积物、花粉或旧记录重建过去生态状况的研究者
senses.example: A historical ecologist traced the lake's decline through pollen layers.
senses.exampleCN: 一位历史生态学家通过花粉层追溯这个湖的衰退。
senses.why: This branch adds time to ecology: a system has a past, and the ecologist reads it in layers. The noun now covers work in cores and archives, not only in living places.
senses.whyCN: 这一分支给生态学加上时间：系统有过去，生态学家在层层沉积中读取它。这个名词于是覆盖了岩芯与档案里的工作，而不只是活着的现场。

senses.title: The consultant: ecology applied to a project
senses.titleCN: 顾问：把生态学用于具体项目
senses.definition: a professional who assesses ecological risk for developers, planners, or regulators
senses.definitionCN: 为开发商、规划者或监管者评估生态风险的专业人员
senses.example: The consultant ecologist required a survey before the road was widened.
senses.exampleCN: 这位生态咨询顾问要求在拓宽道路之前先做一次调查。
senses.why: In planning law, ecological knowledge becomes a check on construction. The person noun takes on a commercial role, but the object remains the same: which relations will this project cut?
senses.whyCN: 在规划法中，生态知识成为对建设的审查。这个人称名词带上了商业角色，但对象没变：这个项目会切断哪些关系？

intro.en: Ecologist is ecology plus -ist, the person suffix from Greek -istēs. Ecology was coined by Ernst Haeckel in 1866 from Greek oikos 'house' and -logia 'study'. The first English uses of ecologist date from the late 19th century, though the exact year is not certain.
intro.cn: ecologist 是 ecology 加 -ist，后者出自希腊语 -istēs 的人物后缀。ecology 由恩斯特·海克尔于 1866 年用希腊语 oikos“房屋”与 -logia“研究”造出。英语中 ecologist 最早见于 19 世纪后期，具体年份来源不确定。

items.en: Specialisms multiply: restoration ecologist, microbial ecologist, consultant ecologist, and historical ecologist become ordinary job titles.
items.cn: 专业分支不断增多：修复生态学家、微生物生态学家、生态咨询顾问、历史生态学家都成了常见职称。

items.en: English ecologist is recorded as the science acquires its first journals and university posts; the dating is approximate.
items.cn: 随着这门科学拥有最早的期刊与大学教职，英语 ecologist 见于记载；此处年代为大致估计。

items.en: Haeckel names Oecologie, the study of the relations of organisms to their surroundings, and the person noun follows naturally from the discipline name.
items.cn: 海克尔命名 Oecologie，即研究生物与其周围环境关系的学问，人物名词随之自然派生。

items.en: oikos 'house, household' supplies eco-, and -logia 'study, discourse' supplies -logy; -istēs was the ordinary Greek suffix for 'one who practises'.
items.cn: oikos“房屋、家户”提供 eco-，-logia“研究、论述”提供 -logy；-istēs 是希腊语中表示“从事者”的常用后缀。

items.en: The -ist suffix is productive rather than inherited: English can attach it to almost any discipline, which is why ecologist may mean researcher, advocate, or consultant.
items.cn: -ist 是能产的后缀而非直接继承：英语几乎可以把它加到任何学科名上，这正是 ecologist 可指研究者、倡导者或顾问的原因。

note.en: The first group separates a shared-house relative from a true derivative and an accidental neighbour; the second compares words that share only part of the meaning.
note.cn: 第一组区分一个同屋同源的词、一个真正的派生词和一个偶然撞形的词；第二组比较只共享部分含义的词。

entries.definition: one who studies the production and use of wealth. It shares oikos 'house' but joins it to nomos 'managing', not to logia 'study'.
entries.definitionCN: 研究财富生产与使用的人。它与 ecologist 共享 oikos“房屋”，但接的是 nomos“管理”，不是 logia“研究”。

entries.definition: the adjective of ecology, describing relations rather than a person. Ecologist is the human counterpart of the same stem.
entries.definitionCN: ecology 的形容词，描述关系而非人。ecologist 是同一词干上的人物对应词。

entries.definition: selecting from many sources. Greek eklektikos 'selective' has no connection with oikos or -logia.
entries.definitionCN: 从多种来源中选取的。希腊语 eklektikos“挑选的”与 oikos、-logia 均无关联。

entries.definition: a scientist who studies living things generally. Ecology is one branch of biology, so ecologist is narrower and relation-focused.
entries.definitionCN: 泛研究生命的科学家。生态学是生物学的一个分支，所以 ecologist 范围更窄、更聚焦关系。

entries.definition: a person who campaigns for environmental protection. It names a stance, while ecologist names a training.
entries.definitionCN: 为环境保护奔走的人。它指立场，而 ecologist 指专业训练。

entries.definition: a person who studies nature by observation, often without formal experiment. Ecologist implies measurement and hypothesis, naturalist implies close watching.
entries.definitionCN: 以观察研究自然的人，常不做正式实验。ecologist 含测量与假设，naturalist 含细致观看。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real parts of the word and its real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想只使用这个词真实的构成成分和真实同族词，不用编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: ecologist is ecology plus -ist, the same -ist that makes biologist and geologist.
normal.cn: ecologist 是 ecology 加 -ist，和 biologist、geologist 里的 -ist 一样。

normal.en: eco- is Greek oikos 'house', so the ecologist studies the household of life.
normal.cn: eco- 是希腊语 oikos“房屋”，所以生态学家研究的是生命这户人家。

normal.en: Economist and ecologist share oikos but split at the second element: nomos 'manage' versus logia 'study'.
normal.cn: economist 与 ecologist 共享 oikos，却在第二截分开：nomos“管理”对 logia“研究”。

normal.en: The -ist does not only mean 'scientist': it also covers the advocate and the consultant.
normal.cn: -ist 不只表示“科学家”，也覆盖倡导者和顾问。

normal.en: A field ecologist carries boots and nets; a theoretical ecologist carries equations; both carry the same word.
normal.cn: 野外生态学家带靴子和网，理论生态学家带方程，两者都带同一个词。

abstract.en: Picture a person kneeling in a stream, counting what lives under stones, because the web is invisible unless someone counts its knots.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人跪在溪里数石头下的生物，因为这张网若不数结，就看不见。

abstract.en: The same person may later testify, model, replant a quarry, or sign a survey for a road.
abstract.cn: 同一个人后来可以去作证、做模型、在采石场补种，或为一条道路签调查报告。

abstract.en: Every sense asks who is counting the web, and for what purpose.
abstract.cn: 每个义项都在问：是谁在数这张网，又为了什么。

examples.en: The ecologist found that removing one predator reshaped the whole pond.
examples.cn: 这位生态学家发现，移除一种捕食者改变了整个池塘。

examples.en: Consultant ecologists must survey the site before construction.
examples.cn: 生态咨询顾问必须在施工前勘察场地。

examples.en: A restoration ecologist spent five years reweaving the floodplain.
examples.cn: 一位修复生态学家花了五年重建这片洪泛平原的生态联系。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「一口逻辑事」——一口水一口土都要讲逻辑，专门研究它的人 → ecologist 生态学家

root: 希腊语 oikos“房屋、家户”＋-logia“研究”构成 ecology；再加 -ist（希腊语 -istēs，表示从事者）→ ecologist。核心是“数清生命之家户里各种关系的人”。

sensesIntro.en: All eight senses name the same role: someone who reads the web of relations. What varies is the setting and the purpose — a laboratory, a stream, a hearing, a model, a quarry, a taxon, a sediment core, a planning office.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项命名的是同一个角色：读那张关系之网的人。变化的是场景与目的——实验室、溪流、听证会、模型、采石场、某类群、沉积岩芯、规划办公室。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a person kneels in shallow water, counting larvae under stones.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个人跪在浅水里，数石头下的幼虫。

branches.en: THE PROFESSION AND ITS METHOD: the discipline creates the title, and the field forces the practitioner outdoors.
branches.cn: 专业与方法：学科造出头衔，野外又把这个从业者赶到户外。

branches.en: PROTECTION: findings become testimony when a habitat cannot speak for itself.
branches.cn: 保护：当生境无法为自己发言时，研究结论就成了证词。

branches.en: ABSTRACTION: relations become parameters, and the ecologist works with equations instead of quadrats.
branches.cn: 抽象化：关系变成参数，生态学家用方程代替样方工作。

branches.en: SPECIALISATION: the role narrows either by purpose (restoration) or by taxon (plant, microbe).
branches.cn: 专门化：角色或按目的收窄（修复），或按类群收窄（植物、微生物）。

branches.en: TWO OUTER ROLES: one reads the past in sediments, the other reads the future in a project's plans.
branches.cn: 两个外围角色：一个在沉积物里读过去，一个在项目图纸里读未来。

intro.en: Ecologist is ecology plus -ist. -ist, from Greek -istēs, names a person who practises an art or science; English attaches it freely to discipline names.
intro.cn: ecologist 是 ecology 加 -ist。-ist 出自希腊语 -istēs，表示从事某种技艺或科学的人；英语可以自由地把它加到学科名上。

latinIntro.en: The Greek base is oikos 'house' plus -logia 'study'. The same oikos appears in economy, and the same -logia in biology and geology.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊词基是 oikos“房屋”加 -logia“研究”。同一个 oikos 见于 economy，同一个 -logia 见于 biology 与 geology。

items.meaningCN: 研究生态学的人（-ist 表示从业者）
items.example: The ecologist mapped the nesting sites.
items.exampleCN: 这位生态学家绘制了筑巢地点图。

items.meaning: the science of organisms and environments
items.meaningCN: 研究生物与其环境的科学
items.example: Ecology answers questions about relations, not just species.
items.exampleCN: 生态学回答的是关系问题，而不只是物种问题。

items.meaning: of ecology or of organism-environment relations
items.example: The site has high ecological value.
items.exampleCN: 这处场地具有很高的生态价值。

items.meaning: in ecological terms, from an ecological standpoint
items.meaningCN: 从生态角度看；在生态上
items.exampleCN: 这个方案在生态上是合理的。

items.meaning: a political philosophy centred on ecology
items.meaningCN: 以生态为中心的政治理念（-ism 表示主义）
items.example: Ecologism treats nature as a political subject.
items.exampleCN: 生态主义把自然当作政治主体。

items.meaningCN: 研究生命的研究者（生物学家）
items.exampleCN: 这位生物学家专门研究蝙蝠。

items.meaning: one who studies rocks and earth history
items.meaningCN: 研究岩石与地球历史的人（地质学家）
items.example: A geologist dated the ash layer.
items.exampleCN: 一位地质学家测定了火山灰层的年代。

items.meaning: one who studies production, wealth and markets
items.meaningCN: 研究生产、财富与市场的人（经济学家）
items.exampleCN: 这位经济学家预测增长放缓。

items.meaning: one who campaigns to protect nature
items.meaningCN: 致力于保护自然的人（自然保护者）
items.exampleCN: 自然保护者反对这座大坝。

items.meaning: one devoted to a narrow field
items.meaningCN: 专攻某一狭窄领域的人（专家）
items.example: The specialist identified the rare moss.
items.exampleCN: 这位专家辨认出了那种稀有苔藓。

latinEntries.meaningCN: 从事者；追随者（后被英语吸收为 -ist）

latinEntries.meaning: study of the household of nature

definition_zh: 生态学；生物与环境关系的总体；生态系统的运作状态；生态保护运动；人类生态学；深层生态学；某一专门分支（如微生物生态学）；相互关联的系统隐喻
definition_en: the scientific study of the relations between organisms and their environments, and by extension the system of those relations, its condition, or a movement that treats it as a political object
core_image: 一座玻璃房里的所有生物、水、土和光都被放在同一张关系图上
scene: 密封的玻璃温室里，每株植物、每滴水、每粒土与每束光都标在同一张关系图上。Inside the sealed glass house, every plant, drop of water, grain of soil and ray of light appears on one relation chart. Ecology is the study of exactly these relations.
sceneCN: 这里 ecology 是「生态学，把生物与环境当作一个关系系统来研究」（第 1 个义项：生态学）；句意：生态学研究的正是这些关系。图中可辨识物件：玻璃温室、植物、水珠、土粒、光线、墙上的关系图。

pos.zh: 生态学；生态系统；生态关系；生态保护运动

collocations.zh: 深层生态学（自然具有内在价值的理念）

senses.title: The discipline: the science of relations
senses.titleCN: 学科：研究关系的科学
senses.definition: the branch of biology that studies how organisms interact with one another and with their surroundings
senses.definitionCN: 研究生物如何彼此互动、以及如何与环境互动的生物学分支
senses.example: Ecology asks how a change in one species propagates through a community.
senses.exampleCN: 生态学追问一个物种的变化如何传遍整个群落。
senses.why: Haeckel coined Oecologie in 1866 from Greek oikos 'house' and -logia 'study'. The name imagines nature as one household whose members cannot be understood alone.
senses.whyCN: 海克尔于 1866 年用希腊语 oikos“房屋”与 -logia“研究”造出 Oecologie。这个名字把自然想象成一户人家，成员无法被孤立地理解。

senses.title: The relations themselves: how the parts hang together
senses.titleCN: 关系本身：各部分如何彼此牵连
senses.definition: the set of interactions that link organisms to each other and to their physical setting
senses.definitionCN: 把生物彼此、以及把生物与物理环境联系起来的互动总体
senses.example: The ecology of the salt marsh depends on the tide more than on rainfall.
senses.exampleCN: 这片盐沼的生态关系更多取决于潮汐，而非降雨。
senses.why: The suffix -logy names a study, but English often uses the noun for the object studied as well. Metonymy moves the word from the account to the thing accounted for.
senses.whyCN: -logy 命名的是“研究”，但英语常把这个名词也用于被研究的对象。转喻让词从“论述”移到“被论述之物”。

senses.title: The system itself: a place taken as a whole
senses.titleCN: 系统本身：把一处地方当作整体
senses.definition: a particular community and its environment considered as a working unit
senses.definitionCN: 被当作运作单元来看待的某一群落及其环境
senses.example: The pond's ecology collapsed after the oxygen dropped.
senses.exampleCN: 溶氧下降后，这个池塘的生态系统崩溃了。
senses.why: Saying 'the ecology of the pond' treats a place as an object with a working order. The word licenses statements about health, collapse, and recovery, which a mere species list would not.
senses.whyCN: 说“这个池塘的 ecology”就是把一处地方当成有运作秩序的对象。这个词使“健康、崩溃、恢复”这类说法成立，而单靠物种清单做不到。

senses.title: The movement: ecology as a political cause
senses.titleCN: 运动：把生态当作政治议题
senses.definition: an organised movement that seeks to protect ecosystems and limit environmental damage
senses.definitionCN: 旨在保护生态系统、限制环境破坏的有组织运动
senses.example: The ecology movement forced the plant to publish its emissions.
senses.exampleCN: 生态保护运动迫使这家工厂公布排放数据。
senses.why: Once the science showed that damage spreads through the web, the noun could name the campaign built on those findings. Ecology became a label for a politics, not only a course.
senses.whyCN: 一旦科学证明破坏会沿网扩散，这个名词就能命名建立在这些发现之上的运动。ecology 成了一个政治标签，而不只是一门课。

senses.title: Human ecology: people inside the web
senses.titleCN: 人类生态学：人也在网中
senses.definition: the study of human societies as parts of ecological systems, including resource use and settlement patterns
senses.definitionCN: 把人类社会当作生态系统的组成部分来研究，包括资源利用与聚落格局
senses.example: Human ecology links city growth to the water supply of the plain.
senses.exampleCN: 人类生态学把城市增长与平原的供水联系起来。
senses.why: The compound puts humans back among the organisms rather than outside nature. The same relational logic now covers food, housing and waste.
senses.whyCN: 这个复合词把人放回生物之中，而不是置于自然之外。同一套关系逻辑现在覆盖食物、住房与废物。

senses.title: Deep ecology: nature with its own value
senses.titleCN: 深层生态学：自然自身的价值
senses.definition: a philosophy holding that ecosystems have intrinsic worth independent of human use
senses.definitionCN: 认为生态系统具有独立于人类用途的内在价值的哲学
senses.example: Deep ecology rejects the idea that a forest is only a timber reserve.
senses.exampleCN: 深层生态学反对“森林只是一座木材储备”的观点。
senses.why: The adjective 'deep' marks a shift from managing nature for people to asking whether it has claims of its own. Ecology here becomes an ethics, not a measurement.
senses.whyCN: 形容词“deep”标记一次转向：从“为人管理自然”转向“自然是否有自身的主张”。这里的 ecology 成了伦理学，而不是测量。

senses.title: A named branch: ecology plus a subject
senses.titleCN: 分支学科：生态学加上某个对象
senses.definition: a specialised field formed by joining ecology to the organisms or setting studied, as in microbial or chemical ecology
senses.definitionCN: 把生态学与所研究的生物或场景结合而成的专门领域，如微生物生态学、化学生态学
senses.example: Chemical ecology explains how a plant's scent calls its predators' enemies.
senses.exampleCN: 化学生态学解释了植物的气味如何召来捕食者的天敌。
senses.why: The noun is productive in compounds because relations can be studied at any scale. The modifier says which scale or signal is in view.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词在复合词中很有能产性，因为关系可以在任何尺度上研究。修饰语说明所看的是哪个尺度或哪种信号。

senses.title: A system metaphor: any field of interdependence
senses.titleCN: 系统隐喻：任何相互依赖的领域
senses.definition: the pattern of interdependence within a non-biological system, such as media, software, or knowledge
senses.definitionCN: 非生物系统（如媒介、软件、知识）内部相互依赖的格局
senses.example: The 'information ecology' of a newsroom shapes which stories survive.
senses.exampleCN: 新闻编辑室的“信息生态”决定了哪些报道能活下来。
senses.why: Because ecology's core is relation rather than biology, the word travels: an ecology of media has niches, flows and extinctions too. The metaphor borrows structure, not organisms.
senses.whyCN: 因为 ecology 的核心是关系而非生物，这个词可以迁移：媒介生态也有生态位、流动与灭绝。隐喻借用的是结构，而非生物。

intro.en: Ecology was coined as a scientific term, not inherited. Ernst Haeckel proposed Oecologie in 1866 from Greek oikos 'house, dwelling' and -logia 'study, discourse'. English adopted it in the 1870s. The claim that the term was first used in 1866 rather than 1869 rests on Haeckel's own account and is generally accepted.
intro.cn: ecology 是作为科学术语被造出的，而非继承而来。恩斯特·海克尔于 1866 年用希腊语 oikos“房屋、居所”与 -logia“研究、论述”提出 Oecologie。英语一般认为在 1870 年代采用。关于该词最早使用于 1866 年而非 1869 年，依据是海克尔本人的记述，一般被接受。

items.en: The noun spreads beyond biology into human ecology, deep ecology, media ecology, and political language.
items.cn: 这个名词越出生物学，进入人类生态学、深层生态学、媒介生态学与政治语言。

items.en: English ecology is recorded, and the word enters textbooks and journals alongside the new German science.
items.cn: 英语 ecology 一般认为在 1870 年代见于记载（确切年份来源不确定），随着这门新的德国科学进入教科书与期刊。

items.en: Haeckel proposes Oecologie for the body of knowledge about the relations of organisms to their environment.
items.cn: 海克尔提出 Oecologie，指关于生物与其环境关系的知识总体。

items.en: oikos 'house, household' supplies the first element, and -logia 'study, discourse' the second. The same oikos gives economy; the same -logia gives biology.
items.cn: oikos“房屋、家户”提供第一成分，-logia“研究、论述”提供第二成分。同一个 oikos 给出 economy；同一个 -logia 给出 biology。

items.en: Haeckel's original spelling Oecologie reflects the Greek oikos with an oe-; English simplified it to eco-. The 'household' image is deliberate, not decorative.
items.cn: 海克尔原拼 Oecologie 用 oe- 反映希腊语 oikos；英语简化为 eco-。“家户”意象是有意为之，不是装饰。

note.en: The first group separates a shared-oikos relative from a derivative and a real lexical neighbour; the second compares words that share only part of the meaning.
note.cn: 第一组区分一个共享 oikos 的同源词、一个派生词和一个真正相邻的词；第二组比较只共享部分含义的词。

entries.definition: the management of resources. It joins oikos 'house' to nomos 'managing, law', so it names household management rather than the study of life.
entries.definitionCN: 资源的管理。它把 oikos“房屋”接到 nomos“管理、法则”上，因此命名的是家务管理，而非生命研究。

entries.definition: a community and its environment as one unit. It was built in 1935 from ecology plus system, so it names one object of ecology rather than the discipline.
entries.definitionCN: 群落与其环境构成的整体。它于 1935 年由 ecology 加 system 造成，命名的是生态学的一个对象，而非学科本身。

entries.definition: the study of animal behaviour. Its root is Greek ethos 'character, habit', not oikos 'house'.
entries.definitionCN: 动物行为学。其词根是希腊语 ethos“性格、习性”，不是 oikos“房屋”。

entries.definition: the study of living things in general. Ecology is a branch of biology that concentrates on relations and environments.
entries.definitionCN: 泛研究生命的科学。生态学是生物学的一个分支，集中于关系与环境。

entries.definition: an interdisciplinary field focused on environmental problems and solutions. It is more applied and more human-centred than ecology.
entries.definitionCN: 聚焦环境问题与对策的交叉领域。它比 ecology 更应用、更以人为中心。

entries.definition: an older term for the study of organisms in relation to their environment. It has largely been replaced by ecology.
entries.definitionCN: 研究生物与环境关系的较早术语，现已基本被 ecology 取代。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real parts of the word and its real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想只使用这个词真实的构成成分和真实同族词，不用编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: ecology = oikos 'house' + logia 'study': the study of nature's household.
normal.cn: ecology ＝ oikos“房屋”＋ logia“研究”：研究自然这户人家。

normal.en: Haeckel coined it in 1866, so it is younger than Darwin's Origin (1859).
normal.cn: 海克尔于 1866 年造出这个词，所以它比达尔文的《物种起源》（1859）更年轻。

normal.en: ecology and economy share oikos; -logy studies the house, -nomy manages it.
normal.cn: ecology 与 economy 共享 oikos；-logy 研究这座房子，-nomy 管理这座房子。

normal.en: The noun can name the science, the relations, or the system, because the study and its object share one word by metonymy.
normal.cn: 这个名词可指学科、关系或系统，因为“研究”与“对象”通过转喻共用一个词。

normal.en: Deep ecology is philosophy, not filed work: it asks whether nature has value without people.
normal.cn: 深层生态学是哲学而非野外工作：它问自然是否在人之外自有价值。

abstract.en: Picture a sealed glass house where every plant, drop and ray is drawn on one chart.
abstract.cn: 想象一座封闭的玻璃温室，每株植物、每滴水、每束光都被画在同一张图上。

abstract.en: The same chart becomes a science, a place, a movement, a human study, an ethic, a branch, and a metaphor for newsrooms.
abstract.cn: 同一张图可以变成一门科学、一处地方、一场运动、一项人类研究、一种伦理、一个分支，以及新闻编辑室的隐喻。

abstract.en: Every sense asks what is inside the glass and what is connected to what.
abstract.cn: 每个义项都在问：玻璃房里有什么，什么又与什么相连。

examples.en: Ecology shows that a small change in one species can reshape a whole forest.
examples.cn: 生态学表明，一个物种的小变化可以重塑整片森林。

examples.en: The ecology of the estuary depends on the rhythm of the tides.
examples.cn: 这片河口的生态取决于潮汐的节律。

examples.en: Human ecology treats the city as a habitat, not as an exception to nature.
examples.cn: 人类生态学把城市看作一种生境，而不是自然的例外。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「一口逻辑」——一口水、一口土都讲逻辑，研究这层关系 → ecology 生态学

root: 希腊语 oikos“房屋、家户”＋-logia“研究、论述”（logos“言说、推理”，legein“聚集、说”）→ ecology。1866 年由海克尔造出，核心是“把自然当作一户人家来研究其内部关系”。

sensesIntro.en: All eight senses share one chart of relations. What changes is whether the chart is the science, the relations, the place, a politics, a human application, a philosophy, a branch, or a pure metaphor.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项共享同一张关系图。变化的只是这张图是学科、是关系、是地方、是政治、是人类应用、是哲学、是分支，还是纯隐喻。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a sealed glass house whose every inhabitant is drawn on one relation chart.
core.cn: 核心意象：一座封闭的玻璃温室，里面每个居民都被画在同一张关系图上。

branches.en: DISCIPLINE AND OBJECT: -logy names the study, but metonymy lets the same noun name the relations studied.
branches.cn: 学科与对象：-logy 命名研究，但转喻让同一名词也命名被研究的关系。

branches.en: WHOLE SYSTEM: 'the ecology of a pond' treats a place as a working order that can be healthy or collapsed.
branches.cn: 整体系统：“一个池塘的 ecology”把一处地方当成可健康、可崩溃的运作秩序。

branches.en: POLITICS: findings about spreading damage turn into an organised movement with demands.
branches.cn: 政治：关于破坏扩散的发现，转化为一场有诉求的有组织运动。

branches.en: HUMANS AND VALUE: people are put inside the web, and the web is then asked whether it has worth of its own.
branches.cn: 人与价值：人先被放进网里，随后这张网被追问是否有自身价值。

branches.en: SCALE AND METAPHOR: compounds name branches by scale or signal, and non-biological systems borrow the same structure.
branches.cn: 尺度与隐喻：复合词按尺度或信号命名分支，非生物系统则借用同一结构。

intro.en: Ecology is a compound of two Greek elements, eco- and -logy, coined as a unit in the 19th century. Neither half is a Latin affix in the strict sense; both are productive combining forms in modern science.
intro.cn: ecology 是 eco- 与 -logy 两个希腊成分构成的复合词，在 19 世纪作为整体被造出。两半严格说都不是拉丁语缀，而是现代科学中能产的构词成分。

latinIntro.en: The Greek sources are oikos 'house, household' and logos 'word, account, reasoning', from legein 'to gather, say'. The second element appears as -logia in Greek, shortened to -logy in English.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊来源是 oikos“房屋、家户”与 logos“言说、论述、推理”，后者源于 legein“聚集、说”。第二成分在希腊语中作 -logia，英语缩短为 -logy。

items.meaning: the study of organisms in their household, the environment
items.meaningCN: 研究生物在其“家户”（环境）中的关系之学
items.example: Ecology began as the study of plant communities.
items.exampleCN: 生态学最初研究植物群落。

items.example: The ecologist sampled the stream quarterly.
items.exampleCN: 这位生态学家每季度对溪流采样。

items.meaningCN: 生态的；与生态学相关的
items.exampleCN: 这条走廊具有生态重要性。
这片湿地在生态上很敏感。

items.meaning: a community and its environment as one working unit
items.meaningCN: 群落与环境构成的运作单元
items.example: The ecosystem recovers slowly after dredging.
items.exampleCN: 疏浚之后，这个生态系统恢复得很慢。

items.meaning: a boundary zone between two ecosystems
items.meaningCN: 两个生态系统之间的过渡带
items.exampleCN: 鹿在生态过渡带上取食。

items.meaning: a locally adapted form of a species
items.meaningCN: 适应特定生境的生态型

items.meaning: the whole global system of life and its environment
items.meaningCN: 地球生命与环境构成的整体（生态圈）
相互作用生物构成的群落
items.example: The biocoenosis shifted after the flood.
items.exampleCN: 洪水之后，生物群落发生了改变。

items.meaning: the destruction of an ecosystem on a large scale
items.meaningCN: 大规模破坏生态系统（生态灭绝）
items.example: The spill was described as ecocide.
items.exampleCN: 这次泄漏被描述为生态灭绝。

latinEntries.meaning: the study or discourse of something
latinEntries.meaningCN: 关于某物的研究或论述

latinEntries.meaning: the modern Latin form behind ecology
latinEntries.meaningCN: ecology 所依据的近代拉丁构词形式

definition_zh: 经济的；经济学的；有经济效益的
definition_en: relating to the production, trade and use of money and goods, to economics as a subject, or to something profitable
core_image: 报纸头版全是物价、就业与利率的曲线
scene: 报纸头版全是物价、就业与利率的曲线。The country entered a long period of economic growth.
sceneCN: 这里 economic 是「经济的」（第 1 个义项：与生产、贸易及金钱有关）；句意为这个国家进入了长期的经济增长期。图中可辨识物件：报纸头版、曲线图、物价数字。

pos.zh: 经济的；经济学的；有经济效益的

forms.label: 比较级（形容词，多音节用 more）
最高级（形容词，多音节用 most）

senses.title: Relating to the economy
senses.titleCN: 经济的：与生产、贸易和金钱有关
senses.definition: relating to the production, distribution and use of goods, money and services in a country or region
senses.definitionCN: 与国家或地区的商品生产、分配、货币及服务有关的
senses.example: The country entered a long period of economic growth.
senses.exampleCN: 这个国家进入了长期的经济增长期。
senses.why: Greek oikonomia meant managing a household, and the adjective still describes the large-scale version of that management.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 oikonomia 意为「管理家务」，这个形容词描述的仍是这种管理在庞大尺度上的版本。

senses.title: Relating to economics
senses.titleCN: 经济学的：属于这门学科
senses.definition: belonging to economics as an academic subject or method of analysis
senses.definitionCN: 属于作为学科或分析方法的「经济学」
senses.example: The paper uses an economic model to explain migration.
senses.exampleCN: 这篇论文用一个经济学模型解释人口迁移。
senses.why: Once a body of theory grew around household management, the adjective also named the theory rather than the world it studies.
senses.whyCN: 当围绕「家务管理」长出一套理论，这个形容词也用来指理论本身，而不是它所研究的世界。

senses.title: Profitable or viable
senses.titleCN: 有经济效益的：划算、可行
senses.definition: capable of producing enough profit or saving enough money to be worthwhile
senses.definitionCN: 能产生足够利润或省下足够金钱因而值得做的
senses.example: It is not economic to ship the ore by road.
senses.exampleCN: 用公路运矿石并不划算。
senses.why: Management must balance costs and returns, so anything that pays its way can be called economic.
senses.whyCN: 管理必须权衡成本与收益，所以任何能收回成本的东西都可以叫 economic。

intro.en: Economic goes back to a Greek word for running a household, and the modern sense scaled it up to whole nations.
intro.cn: economic 可追到希腊语中「管理家务」的词，现代义把它放大到整个国家。

items.en: Oikos meant house or household, the basic unit of production and consumption.
items.cn: oikos 意为房子、家户，是生产与消费的基本单位。

items.en: Nomos meant law, custom or rule, so oikonomia was the rule of the household.
items.cn: nomos 意为法律、习俗或规则，因此 oikonomia 就是「家户的规则」。

items.en: Oikonomia meant household management and later also the management of public resources.
items.cn: oikonomia 意为家务管理，后来也指公共资源的管理。

items.en: French formed the adjective and English borrowed it in the eighteenth century, when the modern science was taking shape.
items.cn: 法语构成这个形容词，英语在十八世纪借入，正值现代经济学成形之时。

items.en: Economic became the general adjective, while economical specialised in saving money and effort.
items.cn: economic 成为一般形容词，而 economical 专门表示省钱与省力。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the economic family and its common confusions; the near-meaning group gathers adjectives for money and profitability.
note.cn: 形近组收 economic 词族与常见的混淆词；近义组收表示金钱与盈利的形容词。

entries.definition: An adjective meaning thrifty or cheap to run, often confused with economic.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「节约的、使用成本低的」，常与 economic 混淆。

entries.definition: The system of money and trade, or the careful use of resources.
entries.definitionCN: 金钱与贸易体系，或对资源的节省使用。

entries.definition: The academic study of production, trade and money.
entries.definitionCN: 研究生产、贸易与金钱的学科。

entries.definition: Relating to money and its management, especially at a personal or corporate level.
entries.definitionCN: 与金钱及其管理有关，尤指个人或公司层面。

entries.definition: Relating to trade and business, or intended to make a profit.
entries.definitionCN: 与贸易、商业有关，或目的在于盈利的。

normalIntro.en: These hooks move from a household account book to a national budget and then to the test of whether a plan pays.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子从一本家用账走到国家预算，再到一项计划是否回本的检验。

normal.en: Economic begins at a kitchen table: oikos is a house, nomos is a rule.
normal.cn: economic 起于一张厨房桌：oikos 是房子，nomos 是规则。

normal.en: Scale the household up and the same word describes a nation's production.
normal.cn: 把家户放大，同一个词就描述一个国家的生产。

normal.en: Economic can also name the theory: an economic model is not the economy.
normal.cn: economic 也可以指理论：an economic model 不是经济本身。

normal.en: If a plan pays for itself, it is economic; if it merely saves, it is economical.
normal.cn: 一项计划若能自己回本，就是 economic；若只是省，就是 economical。

normal.en: Keep economic and financial apart: one is the system, the other is the money in it.
normal.cn: 把 economic 与 financial 分开：一个是系统，一个是系统中的钱。

abstract.en: Picture a single household ledger opened out until it covers a whole country.
abstract.cn: 想象一本家用账簿被摊开，直到覆盖一整个国家。

abstract.en: The same ledger can show wages, prices, taxes or the cost of a new railway.
abstract.cn: 同一本账簿可以显示工资、物价、税收，或一条新铁路的成本。

abstract.en: Economic means the rules by which a society produces and shares what it has.
abstract.cn: economic 意味着一个社会借以生产与分配其所有之物的规则。

examples.en: The country entered a long period of economic growth.
examples.cn: 这个国家进入了长期的经济增长期。

examples.en: The paper uses an economic model to explain migration.
examples.cn: 这篇论文用一个经济学模型解释人口迁移。

examples.en: It is not economic to ship the ore by road.
examples.cn: 用公路运矿石并不划算。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「伊科诺米克」——报纸头版全是曲线与物价

root: 希腊语 oikonomia「家务管理」由 oikos「家户」与 nomos「规则」构成，其形容词经法语 économique 进入英语；现代义扩展到国家经济与经济学。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses of economic: the real system of production and trade, the academic study of it, and the practical test of whether something pays.
sensesIntro.cn: economic 的三个义项：真实的生产与贸易体系、对它的学术研究，以及某事物是否回本的实用检验。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one household ledger is opened out until it covers a whole country.
core.cn: 核心意象：一本家用账簿被摊开，直到覆盖一整个国家。

branches.en: THE SYSTEM: production, trade and money in a country or region.
branches.cn: 系统线：国家或地区的生产、贸易与金钱。

branches.en: THE SUBJECT: the theory and models used to study that system.
branches.cn: 学科线：研究该系统的理论与模型。

branches.en: THE TEST: whether a plan produces enough return to be worthwhile.
branches.cn: 检验线：一项计划能否产生足够回报而值得做。

branches.en: THE SCALE: the same household idea appears as a nation and as a model of that nation.
branches.cn: 尺度线：同一个「家户」观念，既出现在国家，也出现在国家的模型里。

branches.en: THE ACCOUNT: costs and returns are weighed whether by a state or by a builder.
branches.cn: 账目线：无论国家还是建造者，都要权衡成本与回报。

intro.en: Economic is a Greek-derived adjective; English adds noun, person and negation affixes around its stem.
intro.cn: economic 是源自希腊语的形容词，英语在其词干周围加名词、指人与否定词缀。

latinIntro.en: Greek oikonomia reached English through Latin and French, so the root is Greek while the route is Latin.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语 oikonomia 经拉丁语与法语进入英语，因此词根是希腊语，路径是拉丁语。

items.example: The root names the unit being managed.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根指被管理的单位。

items.example: The second root names the rule.
The compound is the direct ancestor of economy.
items.exampleCN: 这个复合词是 economy 的直接祖先。

definition_zh: 节约的；节省的；经济实惠的；简洁的
definition_en: using money, fuel, time or words carefully without waste, or cheap to buy and run
core_image: 厨房的灯泡换成低瓦数，水龙头也装了限流器
scene: 厨房的灯泡换成低瓦数，水龙头也装了限流器。This small car is economical to run.
sceneCN: 这里 economical 是「经济实惠的、使用成本低的」（第 2 个义项：运行或使用便宜）；句意为这辆小车用起来很省钱。图中可辨识物件：低瓦数灯泡、限流器、小车。

pos.zh: 节约的；节省的；经济实惠的；简洁的

collocations.zh: 对真相有所保留（委婉说法）

forms.label: 比较级（形容词，多音节用 more）

senses.title: Careful with money and resources
senses.titleCN: 节约的：不浪费钱财与资源
senses.definition: using money, fuel, time or materials carefully so that nothing is wasted
senses.definitionCN: 谨慎使用金钱、燃料、时间或材料，不让任何东西被浪费
senses.example: The household is economical with water in dry summers.
senses.exampleCN: 干旱的夏天里，这家人很节约用水。
senses.why: The Greek root meant managing a household; the adjective describes a person who manages without waste.
senses.whyCN: 希腊词根意为「管理家户」，这个形容词描述的是不浪费地管理的人。

senses.title: Cheap to buy and run
senses.titleCN: 经济实惠的：购买与使用成本低
senses.definition: designed to need little fuel, money or effort to operate
senses.definitionCN: 设计上只需很少燃料、金钱或精力即可运转
senses.example: This small car is economical to run.
senses.exampleCN: 这辆小车用起来很省钱。
senses.why: A machine that manages its fuel like a careful household manager is economical, even though it never holds a purse.
senses.whyCN: 一台像精打细算的当家人那样管理燃料的机器就是 economical，尽管它从不拿钱包。

senses.title: Brief and not wasteful in expression
senses.titleCN: 简洁的：表达不浪费字句
senses.definition: using only the words or means needed, with nothing extra
senses.definitionCN: 只使用所需的字句或手段，没有多余部分
senses.example: Her economical prose leaves no sentence to cut.
senses.exampleCN: 她的文风简洁，没有一句是可以删的。
senses.why: Words are a resource too, so the same habit of not wasting applies to language.
senses.whyCN: 字句也是一种资源，于是「不浪费」的同一习惯也用到了语言上。

intro.en: Economical shares the Greek root of economic but took a different suffix and a narrower everyday sense.
intro.cn: economical 与 economic 共享希腊词根，但取了不同后缀，日常含义也更窄。

items.en: Oikonomikos meant skilled in household management, which is the sense the English adjective first carried.
items.cn: oikonomikos 意为擅长家务管理，这正是英语形容词最早承载的意思。

items.en: The Latin adjective passed into learned European use and later into English.
items.cn: 这个拉丁形容词进入欧洲的书面语，后来进入英语。

items.en: Economical is recorded in the sixteenth century with the sense of managing a household well.
items.cn: economical 在十六世纪有记录，义为善于管理家户。

items.en: As machines spread, the adjective came to describe engines and lamps that used little fuel.
items.cn: 随着机器普及，这个形容词开始描述耗油少的发动机与省电的灯。

items.en: Economic took the large public sense, leaving economical with personal thrift, low running costs and spare prose.
items.cn: economic 拿走了大型公共义，把个人节俭、低运行成本与简洁文风留给 economical。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the pair most often confused; the near-meaning group gathers adjectives for thrift and low cost.
note.cn: 形近组收最常被混淆的那一对词；近义组收表示节俭与低成本的形容词。

entries.definition: An adjective for the economy or economics, not for personal thrift.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，指经济或经济学，而非个人节俭。

entries.definition: The system of money and trade, or careful use of resources.
entries.definitionCN: 金钱与贸易体系，或对资源的谨慎使用。

entries.definition: The adverb meaning thriftily, or with respect to the economy.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「节约地」，或「在经济方面」。

entries.definition: Careful with money, saving rather than spending.
entries.definitionCN: 用钱谨慎，宁可存下也不乱花。

entries.definition: Simple and cheap, avoiding unnecessary expense.
entries.definitionCN: 简朴而便宜，避免不必要的开支。

normalIntro.en: These hooks follow a careful household manager into a low-fuel engine and then into a short sentence.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子跟着一位精打细算的当家人，走进低耗油的发动机，再走进一个短句。

normal.en: Economical is the household word, economic is the national one.
normal.cn: economical 是家户的词，economic 是国家的词。

normal.en: A low-watt bulb and a flow limiter are economical made visible.
normal.cn: 低瓦数灯泡与限流器，就是看得见的 economical。

normal.en: A car can be economical because it manages fuel like a careful manager.
normal.cn: 一辆车可以很 economical，因为它像谨慎的管家那样管理燃料。

normal.en: Economical prose wastes neither words nor the reader's time.
normal.cn: 简洁的文风既不浪费字，也不浪费读者的时间。

normal.en: Economical with the truth is a polite way of saying not fully honest.
normal.cn: economical with the truth 是「不完全说实话」的委婉说法。

abstract.en: Picture a tap fitted with a small brass limiter, letting through only what is needed.
abstract.cn: 想象一只水龙头装了小小的黄铜限流器，只放行必需的量。

abstract.en: The same limiting can apply to fuel, money, words or a machine's appetite.
abstract.cn: 同一种「限量」可以用在燃料、金钱、字句，或一台机器的胃口上。

abstract.en: Economical means the flow is cut to exactly what the job requires.
abstract.cn: economical 意味着流量被削减到正好够用。

examples.cn: 这辆小车用起来很省钱。

sensesIntro.cn: economical 的三个义项都在削减浪费：钱财与资源、燃料与运行成本，以及字句。
