definition_zh: 生态系统；群落与其环境构成的整体；某一类生态系统（如森林）；生态系统服务；商业或创新生态圈；数字平台生态；生态系统的健康与韧性；生态系统的崩溃与退化
definition_en: a community of organisms together with its physical environment, considered as one functioning unit; by extension, any interdependent system of actors and resources
core_image: 一片林子里，树、菌根、溪水、昆虫和腐叶被画进同一个循环箭头
scene: 一片林地里，树木、菌根、溪水、昆虫与落叶都被画进同一个循环箭头圈。In one patch of woodland, trees, root fungi, the stream, insects and leaf litter all sit inside the same circle of arrows. That circle of arrows is the ecosystem of the wood.
sceneCN: 这里 ecosystem 是「生物群落与环境构成的整体」（第 1 个义项：生态系统）；句意：那片林地里，树木、根菌、溪水、昆虫与落叶构成一个生态系统，被画进同一个循环箭头。图中可辨识物件：树木、菌根、溪流、昆虫、腐叶层、循环箭头。

pos.zh: 生态系统；相互依存的系统（商业、数字等）

collocations.zh: 生态系统服务（自然为人类提供的益处）

derivatives.zh: 生态系统的；系统层面的

senses.title: The ecological unit: life plus setting as one system
senses.titleCN: 生态单元：生物加环境构成一个系统
senses.definition: a community of organisms and its non-living surroundings interacting as a functional whole
senses.definitionCN: 生物群落与其非生物环境相互作用而形成的一个功能整体
senses.example: A pond is an ecosystem because its water, soil, plants and animals exchange materials.
senses.exampleCN: 池塘是一个生态系统，因为它的水、土、植物和动物在不断交换物质。
senses.why: Ecosystem is ecology plus system, coined in 1935 by A.G. Tansley. The compound insists that organisms and setting be treated as one unit, not as a list of species on a map.
senses.whyCN: ecosystem 是 ecology 加 system，由 A.G. 坦斯利于 1935 年造出。这个复合词坚持把生物与环境当作一个整体，而不是地图上的一份物种清单。

senses.title: A named type: forest, lake, or grassland
senses.titleCN: 被命名的类型：森林、湖泊或草原
senses.definition: a particular class of such units, identified by its dominant vegetation, water, or climate
senses.definitionCN: 按优势植被、水体或气候区分出的一类此类单元
senses.example: Mangrove ecosystems buffer the coast against storms.
senses.exampleCN: 红树林生态系统为海岸缓冲风暴。
senses.why: Once the unit is defined, it can be sorted into types. The modifier names the dominant structure, not a different concept; a forest ecosystem is still one web.
senses.whyCN: 单元一旦被定义，就能被分类。修饰语命名的是优势结构，而不是另一个概念；森林生态系统仍然是同一张网。

senses.title: Ecosystem services: what the system gives people
senses.titleCN: 生态系统服务：系统给人类的东西
senses.definition: the benefits people obtain from ecosystems, such as clean water, pollination, and flood control
senses.definitionCN: 人从生态系统获得的益处，如净水、授粉与防洪
senses.example: The wetland's ecosystem services are worth more than the land it occupies.
senses.exampleCN: 这片湿地的生态系统服务价值高于它所占的土地。
senses.why: Economics re-entered the term in the 1990s: a functioning ecosystem supplies services that would otherwise need costly engineering. The web is now also a budget.
senses.whyCN: 经济学在 1990 年代重新进入这个术语：一个运作良好的生态系统提供那些否则需昂贵工程才能替代的服务。这张网现在也是一本预算。

senses.title: A business ecosystem: firms growing around one platform
senses.titleCN: 商业生态圈：围绕一个平台生长的企业群
senses.definition: a network of companies, suppliers, and customers that co-evolve around a core product or platform
senses.definitionCN: 围绕核心产品或平台共同演化的公司、供应商与顾客网络
senses.example: The phone maker built an ecosystem of apps and repair shops.
senses.exampleCN: 这家手机厂商建立了一个由应用与维修店组成的生态圈。
senses.why: The metaphor took off in management writing in the 1990s: firms occupy niches, depend on partners, and can drive each other extinct. Structure is borrowed, organisms are not.
senses.whyCN: 这个隐喻在 1990 年代的管理写作中兴起：企业占据生态位、依赖伙伴，也能互相导致灭绝。借的是结构，不是生物。

senses.title: A digital ecosystem: devices, data, and users
senses.titleCN: 数字生态：设备、数据与用户
senses.definition: the linked set of hardware, software, data, and users that function together on a platform
senses.definitionCN: 在一个平台上共同运作的硬件、软件、数据与用户所构成的关联整体
senses.example: The update spread through the whole digital ecosystem in a week.
senses.exampleCN: 这次更新一周内传遍整个数字生态。
senses.why: Digital ecosystems have flows, dependencies, and single points of failure, much like a food web. The word is attractive precisely because a technical system can be described as a habitat.
senses.whyCN: 数字生态有流动、依赖与单点失效，很像食物网。这个词之所以好用，正是因为技术系统可以被描述成一种生境。

senses.title: Health and resilience: whether the system holds
senses.titleCN: 健康与韧性：系统撑不撑得住
senses.definition: the condition of an ecosystem in terms of function, stability, and capacity to recover
senses.definitionCN: 生态系统在功能、稳定性与恢复能力方面的状况
senses.example: Monitoring tracks ecosystem health through insect diversity.
senses.exampleCN: 监测通过昆虫多样性追踪生态系统健康。
senses.why: Because the unit has a working order, it can be judged healthy or sick. Resilience adds the question of recovery time, which a species list cannot answer.
senses.whyCN: 因为单元有运作秩序，就可以被判断为健康或生病。韧性再加上恢复时间的问题，而这靠物种清单回答不了。

senses.title: The ecosystem approach: managing people and nature together
senses.titleCN: 生态系统方法：把人与自然的治理放在一起
senses.definition: a management strategy that plans for the whole system rather than for single species or uses
senses.definitionCN: 以整个系统而非单一物种或用途为规划对象的管理策略
senses.example: The ecosystem approach includes fishing families in the plan.
senses.exampleCN: 生态系统方法把渔民家庭纳入规划。
senses.why: Management language converts the concept into a procedure: if everything is connected, a rule for one part must be checked against the whole. The noun becomes a principle of governance.
senses.whyCN: 管理语言把这个概念变成程序：既然万物相连，对某一部分的规定就必须放到整体中检验。这个名词成了治理原则。

senses.title: Collapse: the system losing its structure
senses.titleCN: 崩溃：系统失去结构
senses.definition: the abrupt loss of an ecosystem's structure and functions beyond a point of recovery
senses.definitionCN: 生态系统结构与功能急剧丧失、越过不可恢复的临界点
senses.example: The reef passed a threshold and suffered ecosystem collapse.
senses.exampleCN: 这片礁越过了临界点，发生了生态系统崩溃。
senses.why: A system can fail as a whole even when some species remain. Collapse names that level of failure, which is why the concept is used in policy as well as in ecology.
senses.whyCN: 即使还有些物种残留，一个系统也可能整体失效。崩溃命名的正是这一层面的失败，因此这个概念同时用于政策与生态学。

intro.en: Ecosystem is a 20th-century compound of ecology and system, coined by the British ecologist Arthur Tansley in 1935. It is not a Latin word and has no classical antecedent. system comes from Greek systema 'organized whole', from syn- 'together' plus histanai 'to set up'.
intro.cn: ecosystem 是 20 世纪由 ecology 与 system 构成的复合词，一般认为由英国生态学家阿瑟·坦斯利于 1935 年造出。它不是拉丁词，也没有古典先例。system 出自希腊语 systema“有组织的整体”，由 syn-“共同”加 histanai“安置”构成。

items.en: Business and digital ecosystems borrow the term, and ecosystem services becomes a standard phrase in environmental economics.
items.cn: 商业与数字生态借用这个词，ecosystem services 成为环境经济学的标准说法。

items.en: Tansley proposes ecosystem for the whole unit of organisms plus environment, arguing that ecology must think at the level of the system.
items.cn: 坦斯利提出 ecosystem，指生物加环境的整体单元，主张生态学必须在系统层面思考。

items.en: The word appears in the context of British plant ecology, where 'system' was already used for a whole community.
items.cn: 这个词出现在英国植物生态学的语境中，那里已经用“系统”指整个群落。

items.en: systema 'organized whole' joins syn- 'together' with histanai 'to set up, stand'. Ecology supplies the first half from oikos 'house' plus -logia 'study'.
items.cn: systema“有组织的整体”把 syn-“共同”与 histanai“安置、站立”结合起来。ecology 提供前半，来自 oikos“房屋”加 -logia“研究”。

items.en: The compound is unusual in joining a science name to an object name: the ecosystem is what ecology studies. That is why 'ecosystem' names a thing, while 'ecology' names both a science and its subject.
items.cn: 这个复合词特别在于把学科名接到对象名上：生态系统是生态学所研究的东西。这正是 ecosystem 指“物”，而 ecology 同时指学科与对象的原因。

note.en: The first group separates the parent discipline, a shared-oikos relative, and a genuine different-root neighbour; the second compares words that share only part of the meaning.
note.cn: 第一组区分母学科、一个共享 oikos 的同源词和一个真正不同词根的邻近词；第二组比较只共享部分含义的词。

entries.definition: the science of organisms and environments. Ecology studies ecosystems; the ecosystem is the object, not the study.
entries.definitionCN: 研究生物与环境的科学。生态学研究生态系统；生态系统是对象，不是学科。

entries.definition: the system of production and consumption. It shares oikos 'house' but joins it to nomos 'managing'.
entries.definitionCN: 生产与消费体系。它与 ecosystem 共享 oikos“房屋”，但接的是 nomos“管理”。

entries.definition: affecting the whole body or whole system. It comes from the same Greek systema, but in medicine it means 'throughout the organism'.
entries.definitionCN: 影响整个身体或整个系统的。它同出希腊语 systema，但在医学中指“遍及整个机体”。

entries.definition: a large region defined by climate and dominant vegetation. It is broader than an ecosystem and may contain many of them.
entries.definitionCN: 按气候与优势植被划定的大区域。它比生态系统更大，可包含许多生态系统。

entries.definition: the place where a particular organism lives. It is narrower and species-centred, where ecosystem includes the whole community.
entries.definitionCN: 某一生物居住的地方。它更窄、以物种为中心，而生态系统包含整个群落。

entries.definition: the interacting organisms in an area, without the physical setting. Ecosystem adds soil, water, and climate to the community.
entries.definitionCN: 某区域内相互作用的生物，不含物理环境。生态系统在群落之上加上土壤、水与气候。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real parts of the word and its real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想只使用这个词真实的构成成分和真实同族词，不用编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: ecosystem = ecology + system: the object that ecology studies.
normal.cn: ecosystem ＝ ecology ＋ system：生态学所研究的那个对象。

normal.en: Tansley coined it in 1935, so the word is younger than the science of ecology by about seventy years.
normal.cn: 坦斯利在 1935 年造出这个词，所以它比生态学这门科学晚了约七十年。

normal.en: system comes from Greek systema, syn- 'together' plus histanai 'set up' — parts set up together.
normal.cn: system 出自希腊语 systema，syn-“共同”加 histanai“安置”——把各部分立在一起。

normal.en: A community is only the living part; an ecosystem adds water, soil, air and light.
normal.cn: 群落只是“活的部分”；生态系统还要加上水、土、空气与光。

normal.en: Business ecosystem is a metaphor: niches and extinction, but no soil.
normal.cn: 商业生态圈是隐喻：有生态位与灭绝，却没有土壤。

abstract.en: Picture a woodland drawn as a circle of arrows: leaf to soil, soil to root, root to tree, tree to insect, insect back to leaf.
abstract.cn: 想象一片林地被画成一圈箭头：落叶到土壤，土壤到根，根到树，树到昆虫，昆虫再回到落叶。

abstract.en: The same circle becomes a service budget, a company network, a device platform, a health report, a management rule, and a collapse threshold.
abstract.cn: 同一个循环可以变成服务预算、公司网络、设备平台、健康报告、管理规则与崩溃阈值。

abstract.en: Every sense asks what is inside the circle and what happens when one arrow breaks.
abstract.cn: 每个义项都在问：圈里有什么，以及当一支箭头断掉时会发生什么。

examples.en: The salt marsh is a single ecosystem linking tide, mud and grass.
examples.cn: 这片盐沼是一个把潮水、泥滩与草连结起来的单一生态系统。

examples.en: Pollinators are an ecosystem service that farmers rarely pay for.
examples.cn: 传粉者是一项农民很少付费的生态系统服务。

examples.en: The startup joined a wider ecosystem of suppliers and app makers.
examples.cn: 这家初创公司加入了由供应商与应用开发者构成的更大生态圈。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「一口细思疼」——一口水一口土细细想来都牵一发动全身 → ecosystem 生态系统

root: ecology（希腊语 oikos“房屋”＋-logia“研究”）＋system（希腊语 systema“有组织的整体”，syn-“共同”＋histanai“安置”），1935 年由坦斯利造出。核心是“把生物与环境当成一部共同运转的整体机器”。

sensesIntro.en: All eight senses keep one circle of arrows. What changes is the scale or the use: a pond, a type of habitat, a service budget, a firm network, a platform, a health report, a management rule, or the moment the circle breaks.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都保留同一圈箭头。变化的是尺度或用途：一个池塘、一类生境、一份服务预算、一张企业网络、一个平台、一份健康报告、一条管理规则，或圆圈断裂的那一刻。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a woodland drawn as one circle of arrows linking leaf, soil, root, tree and insect.
core.cn: 核心意象：一片林地被画成一圈箭头，把落叶、土壤、根、树与昆虫连在一起。

branches.en: THE UNIT AND ITS TYPES: first the whole is defined, then it is sorted by dominant vegetation or water.
branches.cn: 单元及其类型：先定义整体，再按优势植被或水体分类。

branches.en: BENEFITS: the functioning web is converted into services that can be valued and paid for.
branches.cn: 益处：运作中的网被换算成可估值、可付费的服务。

branches.en: BORROWED STRUCTURE: firms and devices occupy niches and depend on partners, borrowing the web without the biology.
branches.cn: 借来的结构：企业与设备占据生态位、依赖伙伴，借用了网，却不带生物。

branches.en: CONDITION: a working unit can be judged healthy, stressed, or resilient, which a species list cannot express.
branches.cn: 状况：运作中的单元可以被判定为健康、受压或具韧性，而这靠物种清单表达不了。

branches.en: GOVERNANCE AND FAILURE: if all is connected, rules must consider the whole, and failure can occur at the level of the whole.
branches.cn: 治理与失效：既然万物相连，规则就必须考虑整体，而失效也可能发生在整体层面。

intro.en: Ecosystem is a compound of ecology and system, not an affixed Latin word. Both halves are productive: eco- from Greek oikos and system from Greek systema. The compound was coined whole in 1935.
intro.cn: ecosystem 是 ecology 与 system 的复合词，不是加缀的拉丁词。两半都能产：eco- 出自希腊语 oikos，system 出自希腊语 systema。这个复合词于 1935 年整体造出。

latinIntro.cn: 希腊成分方面，前半是 oikos“房屋”与 -logia“研究”；systema 则是 syn-“共同”与 histanai“安置”。

dict_mnemonic.text: ecstasy ＝ ec-（＝ ex-，出）＋ stas（站立，希腊语 histanai）＋ -y ＝「站到自身之外」。古希腊人认为极度喜悦或宗教出神时，灵魂会离开身体站在外面，所以 ekstasis 先是「出神、灵魂离体」，后来才专指「狂喜」。同根 stasis 是「停滞、站着不动」，static 是「静止的」，ecstatic 是「狂喜的」，副词 ecstatically。搭配 in ecstasy（狂喜地／出神地）、pure ecstasy、a state of ecstasy、religious ecstasy；复数 ecstasies 指一阵阵狂喜。近义 rapture 强调「被带走」，bliss 强调圆满的幸福，trance 强调恍惚半睡。注意二十世纪起这个词成为某种聚会毒品的街头名，阅读时按上下文区分「狂喜」与「摇头丸」。

dict_mnemonic.text: edible ＝ ed-（吃，拉丁语 edere）＋ -ible（能够被…的）＝「能够被吃的」。同一词根 edere 还给出 edacious（贪吃的）、comestible（可食的；食品），反义加 in- 得 inedible（不能吃的），名词 edibility（可食性）。注意 edible 有两层：一是「无毒、吃得安全」，用于蘑菇、野菜、昆虫；二是「口感上吃得下去」，barely edible 就是「勉强能吃」。复数 edibles 作名词指「食品」。近义 eatable 更口语，palatable 强调「可口」，comestible 偏正式。别把 edible（能吃）与 audible（能听）搞混，两者只是共用 -ible 这个「能够被…」的后缀。

root: 拉丁语 edere（吃）＋ -bilis（能够被…）→ edibilis（可吃的）→ edible（可食用的；食品）

dict_mnemonic.text: edify ＝ aedis（住所、神庙）＋ facere（造）＝「盖房子」。拉丁语 aedificare 本是实打实的建筑，进入英语后先用于宗教：把人的灵魂当作一座房子来「建造」，于是有了「教化、熏陶、启发」。同根 edifice 是「大厦」（盖出来的东西），edification 是「教化」（盖灵魂这件事），edifying 是「有教益的」。搭配 edify the reader、an edifying sermon、morally edifying；三单 edifies，过去式与过去分词 edified，现在分词 edifying。近义 instruct 偏传授知识，enlighten 偏让人想通，uplift 偏提振精神。注意 edify 与 edit 长得像却不同根：edit 来自拉丁语 edere（给出、产出），edify 来自 aedis 加 facere（盖房子）。

definition_zh: 编辑；校订；剪辑；删改；主编；编辑版本
definition_en: to revise and improve a text, prepare it for publication, cut or rearrange material, or change digital content
core_image: 一双手在稿纸上删、改、挪：把多余的部分剪掉，让留下的部分更清楚。
scene: 编辑花了一上午，把一段长长的文字删改成三个清楚的句子。The editor spent the morning editing a long paragraph down to three clear sentences.
sceneCN: 这里 edit 是「删改文字、让表达更清楚」（第 1 个义项：修订文稿）；句意：编辑花了一上午，把一段长文字改成了三个清楚的句子。场景要点：红笔、划掉的行、页边批注。

pos.zh: 编辑；校订；剪辑；删改；主编
编辑版本；一次编辑改动

senses.title: Revise a text
senses.titleCN: 校订文字：删、改、调整，让它更准确清楚
senses.definition: to read a piece of writing and change it in order to improve accuracy, clarity, or style
senses.definitionCN: 阅读一篇文字并作出修改，使其更准确、清楚或更合风格
senses.example: She edited the report twice before sending it to the board.
senses.exampleCN: 她把报告改了两遍才发给董事会。
senses.why: Latin edere meant 'to give out, bring forth'. Editing is the work that makes a text fit to be brought out in public: what cannot stand is removed, what is unclear is fixed.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 edere 意为“拿出来、产出”。编辑就是让文本适合公开“拿出来”的工作：站不住的内容删掉，不清楚的地方改好。

senses.title: Prepare for publication as editor
senses.titleCN: 主编：对整份出版物的内容负责
senses.definition: to be in charge of preparing a newspaper, magazine, or book for publication
senses.definitionCN: 负责把报纸、杂志或书准备到可出版的状态
senses.example: For ten years she edited the country's leading science magazine.
senses.exampleCN: 她主编这个国家最重要的科学杂志长达十年。
senses.why: The person who edits in this sense does not just fix sentences; they decide what enters the publication and what is left out. Editing becomes a form of gatekeeping.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项里的编辑不只改句子，还决定什么能进出版物、什么被挡在外面。编辑由此变成一种守门。

senses.title: Remove by editing
senses.titleCN: 删掉：把不该出现的部分剪出去
senses.definition: to remove words, scenes, or data from a text or recording
senses.definitionCN: 从文字或录音录像中移除词句、场景或数据
senses.example: The lawyer asked them to edit out the names of the children.
senses.exampleCN: 律师要求他们把孩子们的名字删掉。
senses.why: If editing is making a text fit to be shown, some material must be cut away. The phrasal verb edit out makes the cutting explicit: the piece is removed, not rewritten.
senses.whyCN: 如果编辑是让文本适合展示，就必须剪掉一些材料。短语动词 edit out 把这刀明说出来：那一块是被移走，而不是被改写。

senses.title: Cut and arrange film or sound
senses.titleCN: 剪辑：把拍好的片段重新排列成故事
senses.definition: to select and arrange shots or recorded sound to form a finished film or track
senses.definitionCN: 挑选并排列镜头或录音，形成完成的影片或音轨
senses.example: The director edited the scene so that the argument happens in silence.
senses.exampleCN: 导演重新剪了这个场景，让争吵发生在静默中。
senses.why: Film editing is the same operation as text editing, done with time instead of lines: keep this, drop that, move this earlier. The editor builds meaning by sequence.
senses.whyCN: 电影剪辑与文字编辑是同一个操作，只是用时间而不是行来做事：留这个、扔那个、把这个提前。剪辑者用顺序制造意义。

senses.title: Alter genetic material
senses.titleCN: 基因编辑：在生命的文本上改字
senses.definition: to change the DNA of an organism deliberately, adding, removing, or rewriting a sequence
senses.definitionCN: 有意改变生物的 DNA，增加、删除或改写一段序列
senses.example: The technique can edit a single letter in the genome.
senses.exampleCN: 这项技术能编辑基因组里的一个字母。
senses.why: DNA is written as a sequence of letters, so the language of editing transferred naturally. Gene editing treats the genome as a text that can be corrected at a specific position.
senses.whyCN: DNA 被写成字母序列，所以“编辑”的语言自然迁移过来。基因编辑把基因组当成一份可以在特定位置修正的文本。

senses.title: Adjust an image or photo
senses.titleCN: 修图：裁切、调色、去掉不要的部分
senses.definition: to change a photograph or image by cropping, adjusting colour, or removing elements
senses.definitionCN: 通过裁切、调色或移除元素来改变照片或图像
senses.example: He edited the photo to remove a stranger from the background.
senses.exampleCN: 他修了照片，把背景里的陌生人去掉。
senses.why: A photograph is now a file rather than a print, so changes are made by selection and deletion. The old editorial gestures — crop, cut, correct — survive in digital form.
senses.whyCN: 照片现在是文件而不是相纸，所以改动靠选取和删除完成。古老的编辑动作——裁、剪、改——以数字形式活了下来。

senses.title: Change data or a record
senses.titleCN: 修改数据：改动一条记录或一个字段
senses.definition: to change the contents of a file, database record, or settings field
senses.definitionCN: 改变文件、数据库记录或设置字段的内容
senses.example: Only administrators can edit the payment records.
senses.exampleCN: 只有管理员能修改付款记录。
senses.why: Any stored text can be edited: a record is a small document. In computing the word is neutral and technical, covering every deliberate change to stored content.
senses.whyCN: 任何被存下来的文本都能被编辑：一条记录就是一份小文档。在计算机里这个词中性而技术化，涵盖对存储内容的一切有意改动。

senses.title: Compile a collection
senses.titleCN: 编选文集：把多篇文字收成一本
senses.definition: to collect and prepare a group of texts, essays, or images for a single volume
senses.definitionCN: 收集并整理一组文字、文章或图像，编成一册
senses.example: Two historians edited a volume of letters from the war.
senses.exampleCN: 两位历史学家编了一卷战时书信集。
senses.why: An editor of a volume does not write it; they choose what belongs together and put it in order. Editing here is selecting and arranging, not rewriting.
senses.whyCN: 一卷文集的编者并不写它；他们选择哪些东西该放在一起，并把它们排好。这里的编辑是挑选与排列，而不是重写。

senses.title: One edited version or change
senses.titleCN: 编辑版本：一次改动后的成品
senses.definition: a version of a text or film after editing, or a single change made in an editing session
senses.definitionCN: 文字或影片编辑后的一个版本，或一次编辑中的单处改动
senses.example: The director's final edit is two minutes shorter than the cinema release.
senses.exampleCN: 导演的最终剪辑版比院线版短两分钟。
senses.why: The noun is the count version of the verb: an edit is one complete pass through the material, or one change produced by such a pass.
senses.whyCN: 名词是动词的可数版本：一次 edit 就是从头到尾处理一遍材料，或这一遍产生的某一处改动。

intro.en: Edit is a back-formation from editor, which English borrowed from Latin. The Latin verb edere meant 'to give out, bring forth' — publishing as bringing a work out into the open.
intro.cn: edit 是由 editor 逆构而成的，而 editor 是英语从拉丁语借来的。拉丁动词 edere 意为“拿出来、产出”——出版就是把作品带到公开之处。

items.en: Dare meant 'to give'. It is one of the most productive verbs in Latin, and it supplies the second half of edere.
items.cn: dare 意为“给”。它是拉丁语最能产的动词之一，也是 edere 的后半。

items.en: Edere meant 'to give out, bring forth, publish'. Its past participle editus is the source of edition, editor, and edit.
items.cn: edere 意为“给出、产出、出版”。它的过去分词 editus 是 edition、editor 与 edit 的来源。

items.en: Editor in Latin meant 'one who puts forth or publishes'. English borrowed it in the 17th century for the person who prepares a text.
items.cn: 拉丁语 editor 意为“拿出或出版某物的人”。英语在 17 世纪借入，指准备文本的人。

items.en: The verb edit is recorded in English in the late 18th century, most likely formed by removing the -or from editor. The noun came later.
items.cn: 动词 edit 于 18 世纪后期见于英语，很可能是从 editor 去掉 -or 逆构而来。名词义更晚。

items.en: As film, radio, and recording developed, edit extended from paper to shots and sound. The editor became the person who decides sequence.
items.cn: 随着电影、广播与录音的发展，edit 从纸张扩展到镜头与声音。编辑者成了决定顺序的人。

items.en: Word processors, photo software, databases, and gene technology all reuse the word. Anything represented as a sequence can now be edited.
items.cn: 文字处理软件、修图软件、数据库与基因技术都再次使用这个词。任何被表示为序列的东西，如今都能被编辑。

note.en: The first group is the edere/editor family; the second collects revise words, each with a different kind of change.
note.cn: 第一组是 edere/editor 词族；第二组收“修改”类近义词，每种改动方式不同。

entries.definition: a person who prepares texts or media for publication. English had editor before it had the verb edit.
entries.definitionCN: 把文字或媒体准备到可出版状态的人。英语先有 editor，后有动词 edit。

entries.definition: one published form of a book or newspaper. It comes from Latin editio 'a bringing forth'.
entries.definitionCN: 书或报纸的一个出版形态。它来自拉丁语 editio“产出”。

entries.definition: relating to editing or an editor; also a newspaper article stating the paper's opinion.
entries.definitionCN: 与编辑或主编有关的；也指表达报社立场的社论。

entries.definition: able to be edited. It applies the -able suffix to the verb edit.
entries.definitionCN: 可编辑的。它是把 -able 加到动词 edit 上。

entries.definition: to read again and change in order to improve. It stresses a second look; edit can also mean selecting and arranging.
entries.definitionCN: 重读并修改以求改进。它强调再看一遍；edit 还可指挑选与编排。

entries.definition: to make a small change, especially to a law or document. It is narrower and more official than edit.
entries.definitionCN: 对法律或文件作小改动。它比 edit 更窄、更正式。

entries.definition: to edit text for publication, especially to remove sensitive material. It comes from a different Latin root, redigere.
entries.definitionCN: 为出版而编辑文字，尤指删去敏感内容。它来自另一个拉丁词根 redigere。

entries.definition: to change something partly. It is broader than edit and does not imply improving or preparing for publication.
entries.definitionCN: 部分地改变某物。它比 edit 宽，不含“改进”或“准备出版”的意思。

normalIntro.en: Real parts and relatives: Latin edere 'give out' (e- + dare), and the family editor, edition, editorial, editable, unedited.
normalIntro.cn: 只用真实成分与同族词：拉丁语 edere“拿出”（e- + dare），以及 editor、edition、editorial、editable、unedited 词族。

normal.en: Edit was cut out of editor, just as the editor cuts things out of a text.
normal.cn: edit 是从 editor 里剪出来的，就像编辑从文本里剪东西一样。

normal.en: The Latin base is e- 'out' + dare 'give': to edit is to make a text fit to be given out.
normal.cn: 拉丁词基是 e-“出”+ dare“给”：编辑就是让文本适合被“发出去”。

normal.en: Editor, edition, editorial all come from the same 'bring forth' verb.
normal.cn: editor、edition、editorial 都来自同一个“产出”动词。

normal.en: In film, editing is choosing which shots to keep and in what order — text editing with time.
normal.cn: 在电影里，剪辑是选择留哪些镜头、按什么顺序——用时间来做的文字编辑。

normal.en: Gene editing works because DNA is written as letters; the word 'edit' fits the material.
normal.cn: 基因编辑能成立，是因为 DNA 被写成字母；edit 这个词正好贴合这种材料。

abstract.en: Editing is the art of deciding what the reader will never know was there.
abstract.cn: 编辑的艺术，是决定读者永远不会知道那里曾有什么。

abstract.en: Every cut is an argument about what matters.
abstract.cn: 每一刀删改，都是一次关于“什么才重要”的论证。

abstract.en: A text becomes itself only after something has been taken away.
abstract.cn: 一个文本只有在被拿走一些东西之后，才真正成为它自己。

examples.en: The journal rejected the paper but asked the authors to edit it and resubmit.
examples.cn: 期刊拒了这篇论文，但请作者修改后再投。

examples.en: He edited the interview down to four minutes for the evening news.
examples.cn: 他把握了采访剪到四分钟，用于晚间新闻。

examples.en: Scientists used the tool to edit a gene linked to the disease.
examples.cn: 科学家用这个工具编辑了一个与疾病相关的基因。

dict_mnemonic.text: “挨得特”——挨得特拿红笔一行行挨着改，删到只剩重点 → edit 编辑、删改

root: 源自拉丁语 edere“拿出、产出、出版”，由 e-“向外”+ dare“给”构成；英语先有 editor，后逆构出动词 edit，核心是“把材料修整到适合拿出去”。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses of edit, all one operation: look at a body of material, then cut, change, and rearrange it until it is fit to be shown.
sensesIntro.cn: edit 的九个义项都是同一个操作：审视一堆材料，然后删、改、重排，直到它适合被展示。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand with a red pen, crossing out, correcting, and moving lines on a page.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手拿红笔，在纸页上划掉、改正、挪动句子。

branches.en: TEXT: revising sentences, running a publication, and compiling a volume are three levels of the same editorial care.
branches.cn: 文本：改句子、管出版物、编文集，是同一份编辑功夫的三个层级。

branches.en: REMOVAL: edit out a name, cut a scene — meaning is built as much by what is taken away.
branches.cn: 移除：删掉一个名字、剪掉一个场景——意义同样由被拿走的东西构成。

branches.en: MATERIAL AS TEXT: genes and pixels are handled as sequences that can be cut and rearranged like words.
branches.cn: 材料当文本：基因与像素被当作可像文字一样剪接、重排的序列。

branches.en: RECORDS: a database row is edited like a sentence — a field is changed and the old value is replaced.
branches.cn: 记录：数据库的一行也像句子一样被编辑——改一个字段，旧值被替换。

branches.en: PRODUCT: an edit is one finished pass, the countable result of all that cutting.
branches.cn: 成品：一次 edit 就是完整的一遍，是所有删改的可数结果。

intro.en: Edit's family comes from Latin edere through editor and edition. The suffixes mark the person, the version, the attitude, and the possibility of being changed.
intro.cn: edit 的词族经 editor 与 edition 来自拉丁语 edere。后缀分别标记人、版本、态度与“可被修改”的可能性。

latinIntro.en: The reliable Latin forms are edere 'to give out', its participle editus, and editor 'one who puts forth'. These explain both the 'publish' core and the back-formed English verb.
latinIntro.cn: 可靠的拉丁形式是 edere“拿出”、其分词 editus，以及 editor“拿出某物的人”。它们解释了“出版”的核心与英语逆构动词的来历。

items.meaning: one who prepares text or media for publication
items.meaningCN: 把文字或媒体准备到可出版状态的人（-or 构成施事名词）
items.example: The editor returned the draft with thirty comments.
items.exampleCN: 编辑退回草稿，附了三十条意见。

items.meaning: one published version of a work
items.meaningCN: 一部作品的一个出版版本（-ion 构成名词）
items.example: The second edition corrects several maps.
items.exampleCN: 第二版更正了几幅地图。

items.meaning: relating to editing or to an editor's opinion
items.meaningCN: 与编辑有关的；表达编者意见的（-ial 构成形容词）
items.example: The paper published an editorial supporting the reform.
items.exampleCN: 报纸发表了一篇支持改革的社论。

items.meaning: in editorial matters, or as an editorial opinion
items.meaningCN: 在编辑事务上；作为编者意见（-ly 构成副词）
items.example: The magazine is editorially independent of its owner.
items.exampleCN: 这本杂志在编辑上独立于其所有者。

items.meaning: able to be changed or revised
items.meaningCN: 可编辑的；可修改的（-able 构成能力形容词）
items.example: The shared file is editable by everyone in the team.
items.exampleCN: 团队里每个人都能编辑这个共享文件。

items.meaningCN: 未经编辑或剪辑的（un- 表示否定）
items.example: The archive released the unedited interview for the first time.
items.exampleCN: 档案馆首次公布了未剪辑的采访。

items.meaning: to edit again, often into a new version
items.meaningCN: 重新编辑；再剪一版（re- 表示“再次”）
items.example: The studio re-edited the film for its tenth anniversary.
items.exampleCN: 制片厂为十周年重新剪辑了这部电影。

items.meaning: to correct grammar, style, and consistency in a text
items.meaningCN: 对文稿做文字校对与统一（copy + edit 复合）
items.example: A freelancer copy-edited the manuscript before typesetting.
items.exampleCN: 排版前由一位自由职业者做了文字校对。

items.meaning: to prepare copy under a senior editor
items.meaningCN: 在主编之下做文稿编辑（sub- 表示“在下”）
items.example: She sub-edited the business pages for two years.
items.exampleCN: 她在商业版做了两年副编辑。

items.meaning: to remove a part while editing
items.meaningCN: 编辑时删去某部分（out 表示“出去”）
items.example: They edited out the pause before his answer.
items.exampleCN: 他们剪掉了他回答前的停顿。

latinEntries.meaning: to give out, bring forth, publish
one who puts forth or publishes

definition_zh: 版本；版次；一期；一版（发行量）
definition_en: a particular version of a book, newspaper or broadcast, or the total number of copies produced at one time
core_image: 同一本书在桌上排成几摞，封面颜色各不相同
scene: 同一本书在桌上排成几摞，封面颜色各不相同。The first edition sold out within a week.
sceneCN: 这里 edition 是「版本」（第 1 个义项：同一作品的一次具体出版形式）；句意为第一版一周内售罄。图中可辨识物件：几摞书、不同封面、售罄标签。

pos.zh: 版本；版次；一期；一版发行量

senses.title: A version of a published work
senses.titleCN: 版本：同一作品的一次出版形式
senses.definition: a particular form in which a book, magazine or other work is published, differing from other forms in content, size or cover
senses.definitionCN: 书、杂志或其他作品出版时的一种具体形式，在内容、开本或封面上与其他形式不同
senses.example: The first edition sold out within a week.
senses.exampleCN: 第一版一周内售罄。
senses.why: Latin editio meant a bringing forth; a version is what a publisher brings out at one moment, with its own text and shape.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 editio 意为「拿出、产出」；版本就是出版者在某一时刻拿出来的东西，有自己的文本与形态。

senses.title: One print run
senses.titleCN: 版次：一次印刷的数量
senses.definition: the whole number of copies of a work printed and issued at one time
senses.definitionCN: 一次印刷并发行的一件作品的全部册数
senses.example: The library bought the entire edition of the new atlas.
senses.exampleCN: 图书馆买下了新地图册的整版印量。
senses.why: The act of bringing forth produces a batch, and the batch itself took the name of the act.
senses.whyCN: 「拿出」这一动作会产生一批东西，而这一批东西本身就沿用了动作的名称。

senses.title: A regular version of a broadcast
senses.titleCN: 一期：定期出版或播出的一个版本
senses.definition: one of the regular forms of a newspaper, programme or broadcast, such as an evening edition
senses.definitionCN: 报纸、节目或广播的常规形式之一，如晚报版
senses.example: The evening edition carries the closing stock prices.
senses.exampleCN: 晚报版刊登收盘股价。
senses.why: A daily paper brings forth a new version each day, so each issue is another edition of the same title.
senses.whyCN: 日报每天拿出一个新版本，所以每一期都是同一报名下的又一次 edition。

intro.en: Edition comes from Latin verbs of giving out, and its whole family is built on the idea of bringing something forth.
intro.cn: edition 来自拉丁语中「拿出、发出」的动词，整个词族都围绕「把东西拿出来」这一想法。

items.en: Dare meant to give, and it supplied the second element of the publishing verbs.
items.cn: dare 意为「给」，为出版类动词提供第二个成分。

items.en: E plus dare formed edere, 'to give out, bring forth, publish'.
items.cn: e- 加 dare 构成 edere，意为「发出、拿出、出版」。

items.en: Editio was the noun of that act, a bringing forth or a publication.
items.cn: editio 是这一动作的名词，意为「拿出、出版」。

items.en: French passed the word to English, where it narrowed to a published version.
items.cn: 法语把这个词传给英语，在英语中窄化为「已出版的版本」。

items.en: Printing and broadcasting added the senses of a print run and a regular issue.
items.cn: 印刷与广播又加入了「印量」与「定期一期」两义。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the publishing family; the near-meaning group gathers words for versions and copies.
note.cn: 形近组收出版词族；近义组收表示版本与册本的词。

entries.definition: A person who prepares text or a publication for issue.
entries.definitionCN: 为出版而整理文本或出版物的人。

entries.definition: An adjective for editing, or a newspaper's opinion article.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，指编辑的；也指报纸的评论文章。

entries.definition: A verb meaning to prepare or correct text, film or sound.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为编辑或剪辑文本、影像与声音。

entries.definition: A form of something that differs from other forms of it.
entries.definitionCN: 与同一事物的其他形式有所不同的一个形式。

entries.definition: One number of a magazine or newspaper, or a set of items issued together.
entries.definitionCN: 杂志或报纸的一期，或一起发行的一套物品。

normalIntro.en: These hooks move from a stack of covers to one print run and then to the evening paper.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子从一摞封面，走到一次印量，再到晚报。

normal.en: Edition is a bringing forth: the publisher brings a version out.
normal.cn: edition 就是「拿出来」：出版者把一个版本拿出来。

normal.en: Same title, different cover: that is a new edition, not a new book.
normal.cn: 同一书名，不同封面：那是新版本，不是新书。

normal.en: One printing makes one edition, counted in copies.
normal.cn: 一次印刷构成一个版次，以册数计算。

normal.en: A daily paper is a new edition every day, which is why we say evening edition.
normal.cn: 日报每天都是新的一版，所以我们说 evening edition。

normal.en: Edition, editor and edit all come from the same giving-out verb.
normal.cn: edition、editor、edit 都来自同一个表示「拿出」的动词。

abstract.en: Picture several stacks of one book, each cover a different colour.
abstract.cn: 想象同一本书的几摞，每摞封面颜色不同。

abstract.en: The same stack can be a revised text, a print run, or today's paper.
abstract.cn: 同一摞书可以是一个修订文本、一次印量，或今天的报纸。

abstract.en: Edition means the same work put out again in a new form.
abstract.cn: edition 意味着同一作品以新形态再次出版。

examples.en: The first edition sold out within a week.
examples.cn: 第一版一周内售罄。

examples.en: The library bought the entire edition of the new atlas.
examples.cn: 图书馆买下了新地图册的整版印量。

examples.en: The evening edition carries the closing stock prices.
examples.cn: 晚报版刊登收盘股价。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「伊迪申」——同一本书几摞，封面颜色不同

root: 拉丁语 editio「拿出、出版」由 e-「出」加 dare「给」构成的 edere 派生；经法语 édition 进入英语，后扩展为印量与定期一版。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses of edition: a version of a work, the number of copies printed at one time, and one regular issue of a paper or programme.
sensesIntro.cn: edition 的三个义项：作品的一种版本、一次印刷的册数，以及报纸或节目的一期。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: several stacks of one book, each with a differently coloured cover.
core.cn: 核心意象：同一本书的几摞，每摞封面颜色不同。

branches.en: THE VERSION: one published form of a work.
branches.cn: 版本线：一件作品的一种出版形态。

branches.en: THE RUN: the whole batch printed at one time.
branches.cn: 印量线：一次印出的整批册数。

branches.en: THE ISSUE: one regular version of a paper or programme.
branches.cn: 一期线：报纸或节目的一次常规版本。

branches.en: THE REPETITION: both are the same title brought out again.
branches.cn: 重复线：两者都是同一标题再次拿出。

branches.en: THE BATCH: a version exists as the copies actually produced.
branches.cn: 批次线：版本以实际印出的册数而存在。

intro.en: Edition is a Latin-derived noun; English adds person and adjective endings to the same stem.
intro.cn: edition 是源自拉丁语的名词，英语在同一词干上加指人与形容词词尾。

latinIntro.en: Latin dare, edere and editio are all recorded, so only the deeper Indo-European root is reconstructed.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 dare、edere 与 editio 均有记录，只有更早的印欧词根属于重构形式。

items.exampleCN: 它与 dare 构成 edere。

items.example: The verb is the source of the family.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词是词族的来源。

items.example: It is the direct source of edition.
items.exampleCN: 它是 edition 的直接来源。

definition_zh: 编辑；主编；剪辑师
definition_en: a person who prepares text, a newspaper or a film for publication or release, or who is in charge of a publication
core_image: 稿纸上满是红笔批注，编辑还在删掉一句
scene: 稿纸上满是红笔批注，编辑还在删掉一句。The editor cut a whole paragraph before the issue closed.
sceneCN: 这里 editor 是「编辑」（第 1 个义项：整理文本、准备出版的人）；句意为截稿前编辑删掉了整整一段。图中可辨识物件：稿纸、红笔批注、删去的段落。

pos.zh: 编辑；主编；剪辑师

senses.title: A person who prepares text
senses.titleCN: 编辑：整理文本的人
senses.definition: a person whose job is to prepare written material for publication by correcting, cutting and arranging it
senses.definitionCN: 以修改、删减和编排书面材料来准备出版为职业的人
senses.example: The editor cut a whole paragraph before the issue closed.
senses.exampleCN: 截稿前编辑删掉了整整一段。
senses.why: Latin editor meant one who brings forth; the modern editor brings a text out into the world in its final shape.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 editor 意为「把东西拿出来的人」；现代编辑就是把文本以最终形态带到世人面前的人。

senses.title: The person in charge of a publication
senses.titleCN: 主编：负责一份出版物的人
senses.definition: the senior person who decides what a newspaper, magazine or series will contain
senses.definitionCN: 决定报纸、杂志或丛书内容的资深负责人
senses.example: The editor refused to print the story without a second source.
senses.exampleCN: 没有第二个消息来源，主编拒绝刊登这篇报道。
senses.why: Bringing forth a paper belongs to the person at the top of the desk, so editor also names the post of command.
senses.whyCN: 把一份报纸拿出来，是编辑部最高负责人的职责，于是 editor 也指这个指挥职位。

senses.title: A person who cuts film or sound
senses.titleCN: 剪辑师：剪辑影像或声音的人
senses.definition: a person who selects and arranges shots, scenes or sound recordings for a film, video or broadcast
senses.definitionCN: 为电影、视频或广播挑选与编排镜头、场景或录音的人
senses.example: The film editor built the chase from forty separate shots.
senses.exampleCN: 剪辑师用四十个独立镜头剪出了这场追逐。
senses.why: Film is brought forth by cutting and joining, so the worker who does that keeps the old title of one who brings forth.
senses.whyCN: 电影是靠剪接与拼接「拿出来」的，做这活的人便沿用了「拿出者」的旧称。

intro.en: Editor is Latin in form and meaning: one who brings something forth for others.
intro.cn: editor 的形态与含义都来自拉丁语：把某物拿出来给别人的人。

items.en: Dare meant to give, and it is the second element of the publishing verb.
items.cn: dare 意为「给」，是出版类动词的第二个成分。

items.en: E plus dare formed edere, to give out or bring forth.
items.cn: e- 加 dare 构成 edere，意为「发出、拿出」。

items.en: Editor was the person noun for one who brings forth or publishes.
items.cn: editor 是表示「拿出者、出版者」的指人名词。

items.en: English borrowed editor for a publisher or writer, and the word later narrowed to the person who prepares text.
items.cn: 英语在十七世纪借入 editor，指出版者或作者，后来窄化为整理文本的人。

items.en: Newspapers and film added the commanding and the cutting senses, while the root meaning stayed visible.
items.cn: 报纸与电影加入了「负责人」与「剪辑」两义，而词根含义仍然可见。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the publishing family; the near-meaning group gathers people who work on texts and images.
note.cn: 形近组收出版词族；近义组收处理文本与影像的人。

entries.definition: One published version or print run of a work.
entries.definitionCN: 一件作品的一种出版版本或一次印量。

entries.definition: An adjective for editing, or a newspaper's opinion piece.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，指编辑的；也指报纸评论文章。

entries.definition: The position or period of being an editor.
entries.definitionCN: 编辑的职位或任期。

entries.definition: A person who checks text for errors before printing.
entries.definitionCN: 印刷前检查文本错误的人。

entries.definition: A person who gathers news for a paper or broadcast.
entries.definitionCN: 为报纸或广播采集新闻的人。

normalIntro.en: These hooks follow the person who brings text, papers and films out into the world.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子跟着那个把文本、报纸与电影带到世人面前的人。

normal.en: Editor means one who brings forth; the red pen is the tool of bringing forth.
normal.cn: editor 意为「拿出者」；红笔就是拿出的工具。

normal.en: The editor-in-chief brings out the whole paper, not one page.
normal.cn: 主编拿出的是整份报纸，而不是一页。

normal.en: A film editor brings out a story by choosing which shots survive.
normal.cn: 电影剪辑师通过决定哪些镜头存活，把一个故事拿出来。

normal.en: Edit, editor, edition, editorial: one giving-out family.
normal.cn: edit、editor、edition、editorial：同一个「拿出」词族。

normal.en: A copy editor saves the reader from the writer's mistakes.
normal.cn: 文字编辑替读者挡住作者的错。

abstract.en: Picture a hand lifting a clean page out of a pile of marked drafts.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手从一摞批注稿中抽出一张干净的纸。

abstract.en: The same lifting can produce a book, a newspaper, a film, or a corrected paragraph.
abstract.cn: 同一次「抽出」可以产出一本书、一份报纸、一部电影，或一个改好的段落。

abstract.en: Editor means someone decides what version of a thing the world will see.
abstract.cn: editor 意味着由某人决定世人将看到这东西的哪个版本。

examples.en: The editor cut a whole paragraph before the issue closed.
examples.cn: 截稿前编辑删掉了整整一段。

examples.en: The editor refused to print the story without a second source.
examples.cn: 没有第二个消息来源，主编拒绝刊登这篇报道。

examples.en: The film editor built the chase from forty separate shots.
examples.cn: 剪辑师用四十个独立镜头剪出了这场追逐。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「埃迪特」——稿纸上红笔一圈，整段被删

root: 拉丁语 editor「拿出者、出版者」由 edere「发出、出版」派生，edere 又由 e-「出」加 dare「给」构成；十七世纪进入英语，后窄化为整理文本的人。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses of editor: the person who prepares text, the person in charge of a publication, and the person who cuts film or sound.
sensesIntro.cn: editor 的三个义项：整理文本的人、负责一份出版物的人，以及剪辑影像或声音的人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand lifts one clean page out of a pile of marked drafts.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手从一摞批注稿中抽出一张干净的纸。

branches.en: THE TEXT: correcting and arranging words for publication.
branches.cn: 文本线：为出版而修改与编排文字。

branches.en: THE DESK: deciding what a whole publication contains.
branches.cn: 编辑部线：决定整份出版物的内容。

branches.en: THE CUT: choosing which shots or sounds survive.
branches.cn: 剪辑线：决定哪些镜头或声音留存。

branches.en: THE AUTHORITY: the same person may both polish the text and command the desk.
branches.cn: 权威线：同一个人可能既打磨文本又指挥编辑部。

branches.en: THE SELECTION: in words and in film, the job is choosing what to keep.
branches.cn: 取舍线：无论文字还是电影，这份工作都是决定留下什么。

intro.en: Editor is a Latin agent noun; English adds -ial, -ship and plural endings.
intro.cn: editor 是拉丁语施事名词，英语加 -ial、-ship 与复数词尾。

latinIntro.en: Latin edere and editor are recorded, and the agent suffix -or is visible in both Latin and English.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 edere 与 editor 均有记录，施事后缀 -or 在拉丁语与英语中都可见。

items.example: It is the base of the publishing verb.
items.exampleCN: 它是出版类动词的词基。

definition_zh: 社论；评论文章；编辑的；编辑上的
definition_en: a newspaper article giving the paper's opinion, or an adjective meaning relating to editing or expressing an opinion
core_image: 社论版上只有一篇未署名的长文
scene: 社论版上只有一篇未署名的长文。The editorial argued for a new bridge across the river.
sceneCN: 这里 editorial 是「社论」（第 1 个义项：报纸表达立场的评论文章）；句意为这篇社论主张在河上新建一座桥。图中可辨识物件：社论版、未署名长文、桥的插图。

pos.zh: 社论；评论文章
编辑的；编辑上的；表达意见的

collocations.zh: 编辑委员会；社论委员会

senses.title: A newspaper's opinion article
senses.titleCN: 社论：报纸表达立场的文章
senses.definition: a long article in a newspaper that gives the paper's own opinion on an important subject, usually without a named writer
senses.definitionCN: 报纸上就重要议题表达报社自身立场的长文，通常不署名
senses.example: The editorial argued for a new bridge across the river.
senses.exampleCN: 这篇社论主张在河上新建一座桥。
senses.why: An opinion piece is written by the editorial desk rather than a reporter, so it took the adjective of that desk as its name.
senses.whyCN: 评论文章由编辑部而非记者撰写，于是它把「编辑部」的形容词拿来当名字。

senses.title: Relating to editing
senses.titleCN: 编辑的：与编辑工作有关
senses.definition: relating to the work of an editor, or to the preparation and correction of text
senses.definitionCN: 与编辑的工作有关，或与文本的准备和修改有关
senses.example: The editorial process took three weeks for a forty-page report.
senses.exampleCN: 一份四十页的报告，编辑流程走了三周。
senses.why: This is the plain adjective from editor: whatever belongs to the editor's work is editorial.
senses.whyCN: 这是 editor 的普通形容词：凡属于编辑工作的都是 editorial。

senses.title: Expressing an opinion
senses.titleCN: 表达意见的：带评论立场的
senses.definition: expressing a judgement or opinion rather than reporting plain facts
senses.definitionCN: 表达判断或意见，而非只报道事实
senses.example: The magazine added an editorial note beside the disputed figure.
senses.exampleCN: 杂志在有争议的数据旁加了一条评论性按语。
senses.why: The opinion article gave the word this colouring: editorial comment is comment that takes a side.
senses.whyCN: 社论赋予这个词这种色彩：editorial comment 就是选边站的评论。

intro.en: Editorial is a derived adjective that became a noun when newspapers needed a name for their own voice.
intro.cn: editorial 本是派生形容词，当报纸需要为自己的声音命名时，它又成了名词。

items.en: Editor meant one who brings forth or publishes, the base of the English word.
items.cn: editor 意为「拿出者、出版者」，是英语词的词基。

items.en: The adjective suffix -ial formed editorial, meaning belonging to an editor or to editing.
items.cn: 形容词后缀 -ial 构成 editorial，意为「属于编辑或编辑工作的」。

items.en: The adjective spread in printing and publishing, and American papers began using it for opinion articles.
items.cn: 这个形容词在印刷与出版业传播，美国报纸开始用它指评论文章。

items.en: Editorial as a noun settled on the unsigned statement of a paper's view; the exact first date is uncertain.
items.cn: 作为名词的 editorial 固定在报纸不署名的立场声明上；确切首见年代不确定。

items.en: Broadcasting and online media extended editorial to any comment that takes a side.
items.cn: 广播与网络媒体把 editorial 扩展到任何选边站的评论。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers editing-family words; the near-meaning group gathers opinion writing and comment.
note.cn: 形近组收编辑词族；近义组收意见写作与评论。

entries.definition: A person who prepares text, a paper or a film.
entries.definitionCN: 整理文本、报纸或电影的人。

entries.definition: A published version or one print run.
entries.definitionCN: 一种出版版本或一次印量。

entries.definition: The adverb meaning in an editorial way or in editorial terms.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「以社论方式」或「在编辑层面」。

entries.definition: A regular signed article in a paper expressing a writer's view.
entries.definitionCN: 报纸上由署名人定期撰写、表达其观点的文章。

entries.definition: Explanation or opinion about events, often broadcast or written alongside them.
entries.definitionCN: 对事件的解释或意见，常与事件同时播出或刊出。

normalIntro.en: These hooks go from the unsigned page to the editing process and then to any comment that takes a side.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子从不署名的版面，走到编辑流程，再到任何选边站的评论。

normal.en: An editorial is the newspaper speaking in its own voice, with no byline.
normal.cn: 社论是报纸用自己的声音说话，不署名。

normal.en: Editorial work is what happens before the text becomes public.
normal.cn: 编辑工作发生在文本公开之前。

normal.en: An editorial note does not just report; it judges.
normal.cn: 评论性按语不只是报道，它还下判断。

normal.en: The editorial board is the room where that voice is decided.
normal.cn: 社论委员会就是决定这个声音的那间屋子。

normal.en: Editorial the noun and editorial the adjective differ only in function.
normal.cn: 名词 editorial 与形容词 editorial 只差功能，不差词根。

abstract.en: Picture a page with one long unsigned column and no advertisements.
abstract.cn: 想象一页只有一篇未署名长文，没有广告。

abstract.en: The same page can be a paper's opinion, a magazine's note, or a broadcast comment.
abstract.cn: 同一页可以是一家报纸的立场、一本杂志的按语，或一段广播评论。

abstract.en: Editorial means the institution itself is doing the talking.
abstract.cn: editorial 意味着说话的是机构本身。

examples.en: The editorial argued for a new bridge across the river.
examples.cn: 这篇社论主张在河上新建一座桥。

examples.en: The editorial process took three weeks for a forty-page report.
examples.cn: 一份四十页的报告，编辑流程走了三周。

examples.en: The magazine added an editorial note beside the disputed figure.
examples.cn: 杂志在有争议的数据旁加了一条评论性按语。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「埃迪托里尔」——社论版一篇长文，没有署名

root: editorial 由拉丁语 editor「拿出者、出版者」加形容词后缀 -ial 构成；十九世纪报纸用它指不署名的立场文章，遂转为名词。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses of editorial: the paper's own opinion article, anything belonging to editing, and comment that takes a side.
sensesIntro.cn: editorial 的三个义项：报纸自身的评论文章、属于编辑工作的事物，以及选边站的评论。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a page holding one long unsigned column and no advertisements.
core.cn: 核心意象：一页只有一篇未署名长文，没有广告。

branches.en: THE ARTICLE: the paper's own opinion, printed without a byline.
branches.cn: 文章线：报纸自身的立场，刊登时不署名。

branches.en: THE PROCESS: everything that belongs to preparing text for publication.
branches.cn: 流程线：一切属于准备文本出版的工作。

branches.en: THE STANCE: comment that judges rather than merely reports.
branches.cn: 立场线：作判断而不只是报道的评论。

branches.en: THE VOICE: the article and the note both speak for someone.
branches.cn: 声音线：社论与按语都在替某一方说话。

branches.en: THE FILTER: editing decides what reaches the public and in what tone.
branches.cn: 过滤线：编辑决定什么以何种语气到达公众。

intro.en: Editorial is transparently editor plus -ial; English adds an adverb ending to it.
intro.cn: editorial 的构造一目了然：editor 加 -ial，英语再给它加副词词尾。

latinIntro.en: The base editor is recorded Latin; the suffix -ial continues a Latin adjective ending.
latinIntro.cn: 词基 editor 是有记录的拉丁语；后缀 -ial 延续拉丁语形容词词尾。

definition_zh: 教育的；与教育相关的；有教育意义的；用于教学的；教育机构的；受教育程度的；教育技术的；教育心理与教育不平等的
definition_en: relating to education or to teaching, or serving to instruct and improve knowledge
core_image: 一位老师在黑板上把一道线拉长，学生顺着这条线自己走到了没教过的地方
scene: 黑板上老师把一条粉笔线延长到还没讲过的地方，学生顺着线走进新内容。She turns the extended line into an educational moment for the whole class.
sceneCN: 这里 educational 是「有教育意义的、能教人的」（第 2 个义项：有教育意义的）；句意：她把这条延长的线变成全班的一个有教育意义的时刻。图中可辨识物件：黑板、延长的粉笔线、学生的手、未擦净的旧字、打开的课本。

pos.zh: 教育的；教育性的；有教育意义的

senses.title: Of education: belonging to the institution
senses.titleCN: 教育的：属于教育制度的
senses.definition: relating to the system, institutions, or process of education
senses.definitionCN: 与教育制度、机构或过程相关的
senses.example: The country spends a small share of its budget on educational infrastructure.
senses.exampleCN: 这个国家把预算中很小的一部分用于教育基础设施。
senses.why: Educational is education plus -al. Education comes from Latin educatio 'a rearing, training', from educare 'bring up'. The adjective simply marks what belongs to that process.
senses.whyCN: educational 是 education 加 -al。education 出自拉丁语 educatio“养育、培养”，源于 educare“抚养”。这个形容词只是标记“属于这一过程的东西”。

senses.title: Instructive: able to teach something
senses.titleCN: 有教育意义的：能教给人东西
senses.definition: providing knowledge or moral improvement, often outside a classroom
senses.definitionCN: 提供知识或道德提升，且常发生在课堂之外
senses.example: The failure was more educational than the lecture.
senses.exampleCN: 这次失败比那堂课更有教育意义。
senses.why: Here -al shifts from 'belonging to education' to 'having the effect of teaching'. A museum, a mistake, or a game can be educational without being part of a school.
senses.whyCN: 这里 -al 从“属于教育”转为“具有教导效果”。博物馆、一次失误、一个游戏都可以是 educational，而不属于学校。

senses.title: For teaching: materials made to instruct
senses.titleCN: 用于教学：为教而造的材料
senses.definition: designed or used for teaching, as in educational books, games, or software
senses.definitionCN: 为教学而设计或使用的，如教育书籍、游戏或软件
senses.example: The app was marketed as educational but taught little.
senses.exampleCN: 这款应用以教育为卖点，却几乎没教什么。
senses.why: The adjective becomes a market category: educational toys promise instruction as a product feature. The word now describes intent rather than result.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词成了市场类别：教育玩具把“教导”当作产品卖点。此时它描述“意图”，而非“结果”。

senses.title: Of attainment: how far schooling went
senses.titleCN: 受教育程度：上到哪一级
senses.definition: concerning the level of schooling a person or group has completed
senses.definitionCN: 关于个人或群体完成的教育层级
senses.example: Educational attainment predicts income more strongly than birthplace.
senses.exampleCN: 受教育程度对收入的预测力比出生地更强。
senses.why: Statistics turns a process into a level. 'Educational attainment' counts years and certificates, which is a measurable proxy for what the process gave.
senses.whyCN: 统计把过程变成一个层级。“受教育程度”计年数与证书，作为该过程所给之物的可测代理。

senses.title: Of technology: tools built for learning
senses.titleCN: 教育技术的：为学习而造的工具
senses.definition: relating to digital or mechanical tools used to support teaching and learning
senses.definitionCN: 与支持教与学的数字或机械工具相关的
senses.example: Educational technology promised personalisation and delivered screens.
senses.exampleCN: 教育技术承诺个性化，交付的却是屏幕。
senses.why: The compound 'educational technology' treats teaching as a field that can be engineered. The adjective keeps its institutional sense but attaches to machines.
senses.whyCN: 复合词 educational technology 把教学当作可被工程化的领域。形容词保持其制度义，却接到了机器上。

senses.title: Of psychology: learning as a subject of study
senses.titleCN: 教育心理的：把学习当作研究对象
senses.definition: concerning the psychological study of learning, motivation, and instruction
senses.definitionCN: 关于学习、动机与教学心理研究的
senses.example: Educational psychology studies how feedback changes retention.
senses.exampleCN: 教育心理学研究反馈如何改变记忆保持。
senses.why: A discipline name built on the adjective means 'the psychology of education'. The word marks the application of one field to the concerns of another.
senses.whyCN: 以这个形容词构成的学科名，意为“教育过程的心理学”。这个词标记一个领域对另一个领域的应用。

senses.title: Of inequality: gaps in what schooling delivers
senses.titleCN: 教育不平等的： schooling 所给之物的差距
senses.definition: concerning differences in access, resources, or outcomes among groups
senses.definitionCN: 关于不同群体在入学机会、资源或结果上的差异
senses.example: Educational inequality persists even when funding is equalised.
senses.exampleCN: 即使经费拉平，教育不平等依然存在。
senses.why: The adjective allows policy to name the arena of a gap without naming its cause. 'Educational inequality' locates the difference in outcomes, not in genes or income.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词让政策能说出差距所在的场域，而不必说出原因。“教育不平等”把差异定位在结果上，而不在基因或收入上。

senses.title: Of value: what a thing teaches
senses.titleCN: 教育价值：一物能教什么
senses.definition: the worth of an experience or object measured by what it teaches
senses.definitionCN: 按“能教什么”来衡量一段经历或一个物件的价值
senses.example: The documentary's educational value outweighed its inaccuracies.
senses.exampleCN: 这部纪录片的教益超过了它的失实之处。
senses.why: Value language asks for a return: what did the learner get? Educational value is the pedagogy of an object, whether or not anyone planned it.
senses.whyCN: 价值语言要求回报：学习者得到了什么？教育价值就是一个物件的“教学性”，无论是否有人刻意设计。

intro.en: Educational is education plus -al. Education entered English in the 16th century from Latin educatio 'a rearing, training', from educare 'bring up, rear'. educare is related to educere 'lead out', and the old 'drawing out' idea is often mentioned, though the direct source is educare rather than educere.
intro.cn: educational 是 education 加 -al。education 于 16 世纪经拉丁语 educatio“养育、培养”进入英语，源于 educare“抚养、培育”。educare 与 educere“引出”相关，“把潜能引出来”的旧说常被提及，但直接来源是 educare，而非 educere。

items.en: Educational psychology, educational technology and educational inequality become established compound terms in research and policy.
items.cn: 教育心理学、教育技术、教育不平等成为研究与政策中的固定复合术语。

items.en: Educational is recorded as the adjective of education; the dating is approximate.
items.cn: educational 作为 education 的形容词见于记载；此处年代为大致估计。

items.en: Education is borrowed from Latin educatio, naming the rearing and training of a child.
items.cn: education 借自拉丁语 educatio，指对儿童的养育与培养。

items.en: educare 'bring up, rear' and educere 'lead out' are related but not identical: educare is frequentative in form, suggesting repeated care, while educere stresses leading forth.
items.cn: educare“抚养、培育”与 educere“引出”相关但不相同：educare 形式上有反复意味，暗示持续的照料；educere 则强调“引出”。

items.en: ducere 'to lead' comes from PIE *deuk- 'to lead'. The same root gives duct, conduct, introduce and produce, all involving leading or bringing.
items.cn: ducere“引导”出自原始印欧语 *deuk-“引导”（重构形式）。同一词根给出 duct、conduct、introduce、produce，都含“引、带”之意。

note.en: The first group separates true relatives from two genuine different-root neighbours; the second compares words that share only part of the meaning.
note.cn: 第一组把真正的同族词与两个不同词根的撞形词分开；第二组比较只共享部分含义的词。

entries.definition: a version of a published work. It comes from edere 'give out', from ex- plus dare 'give', not from educare 'rear'.
entries.definitionCN: 出版物的一种版本。它出自 edere“给出”，即 ex- 加 dare“给”，与 educare“养育”无关。

entries.definition: a large building. It comes from aedes 'building' plus facere 'make', with no connection to education.
entries.definitionCN: 大型建筑物。它出自 aedes“建筑”加 facere“制造”，与 education 无关。

entries.definition: the verb behind education, from educare. It is the source relation, not a look-alike.
entries.definitionCN: education 背后的动词，出自 educare。它是来源关系，不是撞形词。

entries.definition: giving useful information or a moral lesson. It is close to educational in sense 02, but stresses the lesson delivered.
entries.definitionCN: 提供有用信息或道德教训的。它与 educational 第 02 义接近，但强调所传递的教训。

entries.definition: relating to formal study at schools or universities. It is narrower than educational and often contrasts with practical.
entries.definitionCN: 与学校或大学的正式学习相关的。它比 educational 窄，且常与 practical 相对。

entries.definition: relating to teaching methods. It is more technical than educational and focuses on how, not what or where.
entries.definitionCN: 与教学方法相关的。它比 educational 更技术化，关注“怎么教”，而不是教什么、在哪里教。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real parts of the word and its real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想只使用这个词真实的构成成分和真实同族词，不用编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: educational is education plus -al, the same pattern as national and personal.
normal.cn: educational 是 education 加 -al，和 national、personal 一样。

normal.en: The root educare 'rear' is related to educere 'lead out': teaching as leading someone out of where they were.
normal.cn: 词根 educare“养育”与 educere“引出”相关：教学就是把一个人从原处引出来。

normal.en: ducere 'lead' also gives conduct, introduce and produce.
normal.cn: ducere“引导”还给出 conduct、introduce、produce。

normal.en: edition and edifice look like education but belong to dare 'give' and facere 'make'.
normal.cn: edition 与 edifice 看着像 education，却分属 dare“给”与 facere“造”。

normal.en: A museum can be educational without being educational in the institutional sense.
normal.cn: 一座博物馆可以是 educational（有教益），却不必是制度意义上的 educational。

abstract.en: Picture a line on a blackboard extended past the lesson, and a student walking along it.
abstract.cn: 想象黑板上一条线被延长到课程之外，一名学生沿着它走。

abstract.en: The same line appears as a system, an attainment level, a toy, a technology, a psychology, an inequality, and a value.
abstract.cn: 同一条线可以显形为制度、受教育程度、玩具、技术、心理学、不平等与价值。

abstract.en: Every sense asks who is being led, and how far past the lesson they go.
abstract.cn: 每个义项都在问：被引领的是谁，又比课程多走了多远。

examples.en: The museum runs educational programmes for local schools.
examples.cn: 这家博物馆为当地学校开设教育项目。

examples.en: The game is educational without feeling like homework.
examples.cn: 这个游戏有教育意义，却不像作业。

examples.en: Educational attainment varies widely across the region.
examples.cn: 该地区的受教育程度差异很大。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「爱就开心脑」——爱学习就开心动脑，越学越有教益 → educational 教育的、有教育意义的

root: 拉丁语 educatio“养育、培养”＝educare“抚养、培育”＋-atio（动作名词后缀）；educare 与 educere“引出”相关，后者＝ex-“出”＋ducere“引导”。educational＝education＋-al（形容词后缀）。核心是“把人从原处引出来”。

sensesIntro.en: All eight senses keep one image: a line drawn past the lesson. What changes is whether the line is an institution, an effect, a product, a level, a tool, a research field, a gap, or a value.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都保留同一个意象：一条画到课程之外的线。变化的只是这条线是制度、效果、产品、层级、工具、研究领域、差距，还是价值。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a teacher extends a chalk line past what has been taught, and students follow it.
core.cn: 核心意象：老师把粉笔线延长到已教内容之外，学生顺着走。

branches.en: INSTITUTION AND EFFECT: first the adjective marks what belongs to schooling, then what teaches outside it.
branches.cn: 制度与效果：形容词先标记属于学校教育的东西，再标记在校外教人的东西。

branches.en: MATERIALS: intent is built into toys and software, so the word describes design rather than result.
branches.cn: 材料：意图被做进玩具与软件，于是这个词描述设计而非结果。

branches.en: MEASUREMENT: the process is converted into years and certificates, a level that can be compared.
branches.cn: 测量：过程被换算成年数与证书，成为可比较的层级。

branches.en: A FIELD OF STUDY: one discipline applies itself to education, producing educational psychology.
branches.cn: 研究领域：一门学科把自身应用于教育，产生教育心理学。

branches.en: VALUE AND GAP: the same line lets policy locate inequality and lets critics ask what an object teaches.
branches.cn: 价值与差距：同一条线让政策定位不平等，也让批评者追问一物教了什么。

intro.en: Educational is education plus -al. The suffix -al, from Latin -alis, forms relational adjectives; English first borrowed education, then added the adjective ending.
intro.cn: educational 是 education 加 -al。后缀 -al 出自拉丁语 -alis，构成关系形容词；英语先借入 education，再加形容词词尾。

latinIntro.en: The base verb is educare 'bring up, rear', related to educere 'lead out' (ex- 'out' plus ducere 'lead'). ducere supplies duct-, visible in conduct, introduce and produce.
latinIntro.cn: 词基动词是 educare“抚养、培育”，与 educere“引出”（ex-“出”＋ducere“引导”）相关。ducere 提供 duct- 词干，见于 conduct、introduce、produce。

items.meaning: relating to education, or serving to teach
items.meaningCN: 与教育相关的；有教益的（-al 构成形容词）
items.example: The trip had real educational value.
items.exampleCN: 这次旅行有真正的教益。

items.meaning: the process of rearing and teaching
items.meaningCN: 养育与教学的过程（-ion 构成动作名词）
items.exampleCN: 教育在学校之前很久就开始了。

items.example: They educated their children at home.

items.meaningCN: 教育者（-or 表示施动者）
items.exampleCN: 这位教育者设计了课程。

items.example: The two districts are educationally unequal.
items.exampleCN: 这两个学区在教育上并不平等。

items.meaning: one who studies or promotes education
items.meaningCN: 教育学家；教育改革推动者
items.example: The educationalist argued for smaller classes.
items.exampleCN: 这位教育学家主张缩小班级规模。

items.meaning: having the power to teach or improve
items.meaningCN: 有教育作用的；能起教化作用的
items.example: The experience was educative rather than pleasant.
items.exampleCN: 这段经历与其说愉快，不如说有教益。

items.meaningCN: 可教育的；有学习能力的
items.example: The test measured whether the child was educable.
items.exampleCN: 这项测试测量这个孩子是否具备受教育能力。

items.meaningCN: 男女同校的（co- 表示“共同”）
items.exampleCN: 这所学院于 1970 年改为男女同校。

items.example: Good questions educe what students already suspect.
items.exampleCN: 好问题能引出学生已有的猜想。

latinEntries.meaning: a rearing, training; the source of education
latinEntries.meaningCN: 养育、培养；education 所本的拉丁动作名词

definition_zh: 教育工作者；教师；从事教育、尤其研究教育方法的人
definition_en: a person whose work is teaching, training or studying how people are educated
core_image: 一个人蹲下来与学生视线齐平，把同一道题换三种说法，直到对方眼睛亮起来
scene: 乡村学校的老师放学后留下来，把不会读的孩子一个个叫到身边，从字母的声音重新开始。The educator stayed after class to rebuild each struggling reader's confidence.
sceneCN: 这里 educator 指以教学与育人为职业的人（第 1 个义项：教育工作者）；句意为这位教育工作者放学后留下来，帮助每个阅读困难的孩子重建信心。

pos.zh: 教育工作者；教师；教育研究者或教育理论工作者

senses.title: A professional teacher
senses.titleCN: 专业教师
senses.definition: a person trained and employed to teach, usually in a school or college
senses.definitionCN: 受过训练、受雇从事教学的人，通常在学校或学院工作
senses.example: The educator stayed after class to rebuild each struggling reader's confidence.
senses.exampleCN: 这位教育工作者放学后留下来，帮助每个阅读困难的孩子重建信心。
senses.why: The word is the agent noun of educate: it names the person whose work is the act, and it sounds more professional than teacher.
senses.whyCN: 这个词是 educate 的动作执行者名词：它命名以这一动作为职业的人，听来比 teacher 更专业。

senses.title: An instructor of a skill
senses.titleCN: 技艺传授者
senses.definition: someone who teaches a practical skill outside a formal school, such as a coach or workshop leader
senses.definitionCN: 在正式学校之外传授实用技艺的人，如教练或工作坊带领者
senses.example: The centre hired an educator to teach safe kitchen practice.
senses.exampleCN: 中心聘请了一位教育人员来教安全厨房操作。
senses.why: Once the setting leaves the classroom, the word widens from subject teaching to demonstrated practice.
senses.whyCN: 一旦场景离开教室，这个词就从学科教学扩展到示范性实践。

senses.title: A theorist of education
senses.titleCN: 教育理论家
senses.definition: a person who studies how learning works and proposes how teaching should be organised
senses.definitionCN: 研究学习如何发生、并提出教学应如何组织的人
senses.example: The conference brought educators and psychologists into one room.
senses.exampleCN: 会议把教育理论家与心理学家聚到同一间屋里。
senses.why: The same noun covers the person who teaches and the person who studies teaching, because both work on the act of educating.
senses.whyCN: 同一个名词既覆盖教书的人，也覆盖研究教学的人，因为两者都作用于「教育」这一动作。

senses.title: A museum or health educator
senses.titleCN: 博物馆或健康教育工作者
senses.definition: a specialist who designs exhibits, programmes or campaigns so that the public learns something
senses.definitionCN: 设计展览、项目或宣传活动以使公众学到东西的专职人员
senses.example: The museum educator rewrote every label for younger visitors.
senses.exampleCN: 博物馆教育员为年幼参观者重写了每块说明牌。
senses.why: Public institutions created new educator roles: the work is teaching, but the classroom is a hall or a clinic.
senses.whyCN: 公共机构创造了新的教育者岗位：工作仍是教学，但教室成了展厅或诊所。

senses.title: An educator who shapes values
senses.titleCN: 塑造价值观的育人者
senses.definition: a person who guides not only knowledge but also character and conduct
senses.definitionCN: 不仅引导知识、也引导品格与行为的人
senses.example: Her old teacher remained an educator in the moral sense long after retirement.
senses.exampleCN: 她的老师退休很久之后，仍在道德意义上是一位育人者。
senses.why: The word can carry the older sense of bringing a person up, not merely instructing them in a subject.
senses.whyCN: 这个词可以带着更古老的「把人带大」义，而不只是教授一门学科。

senses.title: An early childhood educator
senses.titleCN: 幼儿教育工作者
senses.definition: a trained person who works with young children's development through play and routine
senses.definitionCN: 通过游戏与日常作息促进幼儿发展的专业人员
senses.example: The nursery employs one early childhood educator for every four children.
senses.exampleCN: 这家托儿所为每四个孩子配备一名幼儿教育工作者。
senses.why: Professional titles narrowed the word into a recognised occupation with its own training and standards.
senses.whyCN: 专业职衔把这个词收窄为一个有自身培训与标准的公认职业。

senses.title: A corporate trainer
senses.titleCN: 企业培训者
senses.definition: a person paid by an organisation to develop employees' skills or conduct
senses.definitionCN: 受组织聘用、负责培养员工技能或行为的人
senses.example: The bank's educator runs weekly sessions on handling complaints.
senses.exampleCN: 这家银行的教育人员每周开设处理投诉的课程。
senses.why: Business borrowed the school word for adult training, keeping the teaching function but changing the subject to work.
senses.whyCN: 企业借用学校里的词来指成人培训，保留教学功能，却把科目换成工作。

senses.title: Abstract: anyone who shapes understanding
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：任何塑造理解的人
senses.definition: any person or thing that helps someone understand something better
senses.definitionCN: 任何帮助某人更好地理解某事的个人或事物
senses.example: A good editor is an educator in disguise.
senses.exampleCN: 一个好的编辑是伪装的教育者。
senses.why: At its widest the noun leaves the profession behind and names the role of helping another mind change.
senses.whyCN: 推到最宽处，这个名词离开职业，命名帮助另一个心智发生改变的角色。

intro.en: Educator is the Latin agent noun of educare 'to bring up, rear'. Educare is related to educere 'to lead out', from ex- 'out' plus ducere 'to lead'. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: educator 是拉丁 educare「养育、培养」的动作执行者名词。educare 与 educere「引出」相关，后者由表示「向外」的成分加 ducere「引导」构成。年代均为约数。

items.en: Ducere meant 'to lead, draw'. It is the verb behind duct, conduct, introduce and reduce.
items.cn: ducere 意为「引导、拉」。它是 duct、conduct、introduce 与 reduce 背后的动词。

items.en: Ex- 'out' plus ducere produced educere 'to lead out', the image of drawing a person out of ignorance.
items.cn: 表示「向外」的成分加 ducere 构成 educere「引出」，意象是把人从无知中拉出来。

items.en: Educare meant 'to bring up, rear, nurture'. It is closely related to educere, and the two verbs were already linked in Latin.
items.cn: educare 意为「养育、抚养、培养」。它与 educere 关系密切，两个动词在拉丁语中已经彼此关联。

items.en: Educator was the Latin noun for a tutor or one who brings another up, and English took it as a formal name for a teacher.
items.cn: educator 是拉丁语中指导师或抚养者的名词，英语把它接受为教师的正式称呼。

items.en: English educator is recorded from the sixteenth century, and it long meant a person who trains the young rather than an academic theorist.
items.cn: 英语 educator 自十六世纪有记录，长期指培养年轻人的人，而非教育理论家。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date): the precise first English use is not recorded, and the relationship between educare and educere is explained differently by different etymologists.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代）：英语最早用例没有精确记录；不同词源学家对 educare 与 educere 的关系有不同解释。

note.en: Group one separates the agent noun from its own verb family and from one look-alike of a different root; group two holds the everyday names for teaching roles.
note.cn: 第一组把这个动作执行者名词与它自己的动词词族、以及一个异源形近词分开；第二组是教学角色的日常名称。

entries.definition: The process or system of educating; the educator is the person who carries it out.
entries.definitionCN: 教育的过程或制度；educator 是执行它的人。

entries.definition: Producing learning or insight; it describes an experience, not a person.
entries.definitionCN: 能带来学习或洞见；它描述经验，不描述人。

entries.definition: To draw out something hidden; it shares the 'lead out' image but names the act, not the profession.
entries.definitionCN: 把隐藏之物引出来；它共享「引出」意象，却命名动作，不命名职业。

entries.definition: From Latin edere 'to give out', built on dare 'to give', not ducere. It means a published version.
entries.definitionCN: 来自拉丁 edere「发出」，基底是 dare「给」，并非 ducere；它指出版物的一种版本。

entries.definition: The plain, everyday name for a person who teaches; educator is more formal and often implies training or policy.
entries.definitionCN: 教人者的日常称呼；educator 更正式，常含专业训练或政策意味。

entries.definition: A person who instructs in a particular skill or course; educator is broader and can include theory.
entries.definitionCN: 在特定技能或课程中指导的人；educator 更宽，也可包括理论工作。

entries.definition: A person who trains others in a job or sport; the setting is practical rather than academic.
entries.definitionCN: 在工作或运动中训练他人的人；场景偏实践，而非学术。

entries.definition: A person who teaches an individual or a small group; educator can name the whole profession.
entries.definitionCN: 教一个人或一个小组的人；educator 可命名整个职业。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real fixed phrases and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实的固定说法与真实的同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Ducere means lead, so an educator is one who leads another out of ignorance.
normal.cn: ducere 意为引导，所以 educator 是把另一个人从无知中引出来的人。

normal.en: The agent ending marks the person: the verb educates, the noun names who does it.
normal.cn: 表示执行者的词尾标出人：动词是 educate，名词命名做这件事的人。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the settings: professional educator, early childhood educator, museum educator.
normal.cn: 固定说法标出场景：专业教育工作者、幼儿教育工作者、博物馆教育员。

normal.en: The same family gives education and educational, keeping the process rather than the person.
normal.cn: 同一词族衍生 education 与 educational，保留过程而非人。

normal.en: Educe shares the 'lead out' image but means drawing something hidden into view.
normal.cn: educe 共享「引出」意象，却指把隐藏之物引到可见处。

abstract.en: Picture an adult kneeling so that their eyes are level with a child's.
abstract.cn: 想象一个大人蹲下来，使自己的视线与孩子齐平。

abstract.en: Picture a locked room where someone slowly opens the door from the inside.
abstract.cn: 想象一间锁着的屋子，有人从里面慢慢把门打开。

abstract.en: Picture a hand pointing at a letter again and again until its sound finally appears.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手一遍遍指向一个字母，直到它的声音终于出现。

examples.en: The district hired an educator to redesign its reading programme.
examples.cn: 学区聘请了一位教育工作者来重新设计阅读项目。

examples.en: A museum educator turned the storage room into a teaching space.
examples.cn: 一位博物馆教育员把库房变成教学空间。

examples.en: The award honoured an educator who had taught three generations.
examples.cn: 该奖项表彰了一位教过三代人的教育工作者。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「一丢 凯 特」——把人从无知里引出来的人 → 教育工作者

root: 拉丁 educare「养育、培养」的动作执行者名词；educare 与 educere「引出」相关，后者 = 表示「向外」的成分 + ducere「引导」。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses begin with the trained teacher, then widen to skill instructors, theorists, public educators, character guides, early childhood specialists, corporate trainers and finally anyone who changes another mind.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从受过训练的教师出发，再扩展到技艺传授者、理论家、公共教育者、品格引导者、幼教专家、企业培训者，最后是任何改变另一个心智的人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an adult kneels to a child's eye level and tries a third way of explaining.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个大人蹲到孩子的视线高度，换第三种说法再讲一次。

branches.en: THE PROFESSION: the trained teacher, and the early childhood specialist with their own standards.
branches.cn: 职业：受过训练的教师，以及有自身标准的幼教专家。

branches.en: BEYOND THE SCHOOL: a skill instructor outside class, and a trainer inside a company.
branches.cn: 学校之外：课堂外的技艺传授者，以及企业内的培训者。

branches.en: THEORY AND THE HALL: the person who studies teaching, and the person who teaches in a museum or clinic.
branches.cn: 理论与实践场：研究教学的人，以及在展厅或诊所教学的人。

branches.en: CHARACTER: the educator who guides conduct, not only knowledge.
branches.cn: 品格：不仅引导知识、也引导行为的育人者。

branches.en: THE ROLE ITSELF: anyone or anything that helps another mind change.
branches.cn: 角色本身：任何帮助另一个心智发生改变的人或事物。

intro.en: Educator is a Latin verb of leading and rearing, with an agent ending that names the person who does it.
intro.cn: educator 是一个表示引导与养育的拉丁动词，加上一个命名执行者的词尾。

latinIntro.en: Latin ducere gives conduct, introduce, reduce and educe; educare gives educate, education and educator.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 ducere 衍生 conduct、introduce、reduce 与 educe；educare 衍生 educate、education 与 educator。

items.exampleCN: educare 在引导之上加上养育。

items.structure: educate plus a suffix of action
educate plus a suffix meaning 'person who acts'
items.example: The agent ending names the person.

items.structure: educate plus an adjective ending of tendency

items.meaning: to draw out what is hidden
items.example: Educe keeps the 'out' image without the school.
items.exampleCN: educe 保留「引出」意象，却不含学校。

definition_zh: 结果；影响；效果；作用；使产生
definition_en: a result produced by a cause, an impression made on the senses, the state of being in force, or to bring something about
core_image: 一颗石子落进静水，涟漪一圈圈向外推开
scene: 演出进行到一半，舞台灯光忽然压暗，观众席一片安静。The lighting effect made the whole hall hold its breath.
sceneCN: 这里 effect 是「感官印象、效果」（第 2 个义项：灯光、声音等在人眼中或耳中造成的印象）；句意是灯光效果让整个大厅屏住了呼吸。

使发生；实现；促成

senses.title: A result of a cause
senses.titleCN: 结果；后果
senses.definition: a change or result that is produced by an action, event or cause
senses.definitionCN: 由某个行为、事件或原因所造成的变化或结果
senses.example: The medicine had no effect on the fever.
senses.exampleCN: 这种药对退烧没有效果。
senses.why: Effect is Latin effectus, a thing done; a cause does something, and what it leaves behind is the effect.
senses.whyCN: effect 源自拉丁语 effectus，意为「做成之事」；原因做出某事，留在后面的东西就是结果。

senses.title: An impression on the senses
senses.titleCN: 效果；感官印象
senses.definition: an impression produced on the eye, ear or mind, especially by light, sound or colour
senses.definitionCN: 尤指光线、声音或色彩在视觉、听觉或心理上造成的印象
senses.example: The film uses simple sound effects to build tension.
senses.exampleCN: 这部影片用简单的音效营造紧张感。
senses.why: A stage light or a drumbeat does something to the audience, so the result it leaves in the senses is also an effect.
senses.whyCN: 舞台灯光或鼓点对观众做了某件事，于是在感官里留下的结果同样是一种 effect。

senses.title: The state of being in force
senses.titleCN: 生效；有效
senses.definition: the state of being active or legally valid, as of a rule or agreement
senses.definitionCN: 规则或协议等处于运作或法律上有效的状态
senses.example: The new tax is now in effect.
senses.exampleCN: 新税现已生效。
senses.why: A law that has been made is a thing done; once it is in effect, that done thing stands and works.
senses.whyCN: 制定好的法律是一件「做成之事」；一旦 in effect，这件做成之事就立在那里并发挥作用。

senses.title: To bring something about
senses.titleCN: 使发生；实现
senses.definition: to cause something to happen or to bring it into being
senses.definitionCN: 使某事发生或使其成为现实
senses.example: The manager effected a complete change of policy.
senses.exampleCN: 经理促成了政策的彻底改变。
senses.why: As a verb, effect names the act of doing the thing itself, not the result that follows it.
senses.whyCN: 作动词时，effect 指「把这件事做出来」的动作本身，而不是随后留下的结果。

intro.en: Effect comes from Latin efficere, to do or bring about, through effectus, a thing done, and reached English by way of Old French.
intro.cn: effect 来自拉丁语 efficere（做出、完成），经分词 effectus（做成之事）与古法语进入英语。

items.en: Facere meant to do or make and supplied the core of the verb.
items.cn: facere 意为「做、造」，提供这个动词的核心。

items.en: Ex- meaning out plus facere formed efficere, to work out or accomplish.
items.cn: 表示「出」的 ex- 加 facere 构成 efficere，意为「做出来、完成」。

items.en: The participle effectus meant accomplished or brought about, and became a noun for the result.
items.cn: 分词 effectus 意为「已完成的、已做成的」，后来成为表示结果的名词。

items.en: Old French effect kept both the noun of result and the sense of accomplishment.
items.cn: 古法语 effect 同时保留了「结果」的名词义与「完成」的意味。

items.en: English first used it for a result and later for an impression and a rule in force.
items.cn: 英语先用它表示结果，后来扩展出感官印象与法规生效两义。

items.en: The verb use, to effect a change, settled beside the noun in formal style.
items.cn: 动词用法「促成一项改变」在正式文体中与名词用法并存固定。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words built on effect and its easily confused partner affect; the near-meaning group separates result, consequence and impact.
note.cn: 形近组收由 effect 构成的词以及易混的 affect；近义组区分 result、consequence 与 impact。

entries.definition: An adjective meaning able to produce the wanted result.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「有效的」，由 effect 加 -ive 构成。

entries.definition: An adverb meaning in a way that succeeds, or in practice.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「有效地、实际上」，由 effective 加 -ly 构成。

entries.definition: A verb meaning to influence or to move emotionally; often confused with effect.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「影响、使感动」，常与 effect 混淆。

entries.definition: Something that follows from an action; plainer and more general than effect.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「结果」，比 effect 更普通、更泛。

entries.definition: A result, often an indirect or unwelcome one.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「后果」，常指间接或不受欢迎的结果。

entries.definition: A strong effect or influence on something.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「冲击、重大影响」，强调力度。

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from one cause and follow its ripple outward into sensed impressions, standing laws and deliberate action.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子从一个原因出发，顺着涟漪走到感官印象、生效的法规与有意的行动。

normal.en: Effect is what a cause leaves behind.
normal.cn: effect 就是原因留在身后的东西。

normal.en: Sound effects are effects you hear, not results you measure.
normal.cn: sound effects 是你听见的效果，不是你去测量的结果。

normal.en: A rule in effect is a done thing still standing.
normal.cn: in effect 的规则就是一件做成之事仍立在那里。

normal.en: To effect a change is to do it; to affect something is to touch it.
normal.cn: to effect a change 是把它做出来；to affect 是触碰、影响它。

normal.en: Cause and effect are the two ends of one sentence.
normal.cn: 原因与结果是同一个句子的两端。

abstract.en: Picture a stone dropped into still water.
abstract.cn: 想象一颗石子落进静水。

abstract.en: The same ripple can be seen, heard, or written into a law.
abstract.cn: 同一圈涟漪可以被看见、被听见，也可以被写进一条法律。

abstract.en: Effect is the mark left by something that acted.
abstract.cn: effect 就是某个东西行动之后留下的印记。

examples.en: The medicine had no effect on the fever.
examples.cn: 这种药对退烧没有效果。

examples.en: The film uses simple sound effects to build tension.
examples.cn: 这部影片用简单的音效营造紧张感。

examples.en: The manager effected a complete change of policy.
examples.cn: 经理促成了政策的彻底改变。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses of effect: a result left by a cause, an impression on the senses, a rule that is in force, and the verb of bringing something about.
sensesIntro.cn: effect 的四个义项：原因留下的结果、感官上的印象、生效的规则，以及「使某事发生」的动词义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a stone dropped into still water, with rings spreading outward.
core.cn: 核心意象：一颗石子落进静水，涟漪一圈圈向外推开。

branches.en: THE RESULT: what the cause leaves behind.
branches.cn: 结果线：原因留在身后的东西。

branches.en: THE IMPRESSION: the ripple felt by eye or ear.
branches.cn: 印象线：被眼睛或耳朵接住的那圈涟漪。

branches.en: THE FORCE: a made rule still standing.
branches.cn: 效力线：已制定的规则仍立在那里。

branches.en: THE ACT: doing the thing itself.
branches.cn: 动作线：把这件事本身做出来。

branches.en: ONE PROCESS: the measurable result and the sensed impression both come from the same cause.
branches.cn: 同一过程：可测量的结果与被感知的印象都来自同一个原因。

intro.en: Effect is a Latin verb turned noun; English builds a small family of adjectives and adverbs on the same stem.
intro.cn: effect 是由拉丁语动词转成的名词；英语在同一词干上构成一小族形容词与副词。

latinIntro.en: Latin facere, efficere and effectus are all recorded, so only deeper roots are reconstructed.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 facere、efficere 与 effectus 均有记录，只有更早的词根属于重构形式。

definition_zh: 有效的；生效的；实际的
definition_en: producing the result that is wanted, officially in force, or real in practice rather than only in name
core_image: 一把钥匙正好对上锁孔，门一下就开了
scene: 新规定贴出后，门口的长队当天就短了一半。The new rule proved effective from its first morning.
sceneCN: 这里 effective 是「有效的」（第 1 个义项：能产生预期结果）；句意是新规从第一个早晨起就被证明有效。

pos.zh: 有效的；生效的；实际的
